Theory TD_wn_post

section ‹TD with Widening/Narrowing Phases per Unknown and Ghost State›

theory TD_wn_post
  imports Basics Destabilization TD_invariant_lemmas
begin

datatype phase = Widening | Narrowing

locale TD_wn_post =
  fixes T :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'd :: bounded_lattice_bot) strategy_tree"

  fixes widening :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "∇" 65)
    and narrowing :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "Δ" 70)
  assumes widening_ge: "a ⊔ b ≤ a ∇ b"
    and widening_bounded: "b ≤ a ⟹ a ∇ b = a"
    and narrowing_ge: "a ⊓ b ≤ a Δ b"
    and narrowing_le: "a Δ b ≤ a"
begin

subsection ‹Definitions›

definition destab_barrier where
  "destab_barrier x pinfl post stabl =
  (fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl x (stabl - {x})) - stabl) pinfl,
  post - (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl x (stabl - {x}) - stabl))"

definition destab_post ::
  "'x ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap × 'x set" where
  "destab_post x post pinfl' post' stabl' = (if x ∈ post then (pinfl', post')
    else destab_barrier x pinfl' post' stabl')"

function (domintros)
    query :: "'x ⇒ 'x ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'd) map
              ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'd × ('x, 'x list) fmap × 'x set × 'x set
              × ('x, 'd) map × ('x, 'x list) fmap × 'x set" and
  iterate :: "'x ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'd) map
              ⇒ phase ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'd × ('x, 'x list) fmap × 'x set
              × 'x set × ('x, 'd) map × ('x, 'x list) fmap × 'x set " and
     eval :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'd) strategy_tree ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set
              ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'd) map ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'd × ('x, 'x list) fmap
              × 'x set × 'x set × ('x, 'd) map × ('x, 'x list) fmap × 'x set"
     where
  "query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post = (
    let (xd, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post) =
      if x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n then
        (mlup σ x, infl, stabl, insert x p, σ, pinfl, post)
      else (
        let (c⇩w, c⇩n) = if x ∈ post then (c⇩w, insert x c⇩n) else (insert x c⇩w, c⇩n) in
        iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post)
    in (xd, fminsert infl x y, stabl, p, σ, fminsert pinfl x y, post))"
| "iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post = (
    if x ∉ stabl then (
      let (xd, infl, stabl, p', σ, pinfl', post') =
        eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post) in
      let d_new = if x ∉ p then xd else if wn = Widening then mlup σ x ∇ xd else mlup σ x Δ xd in
      if d_new = mlup σ x then (
        if x ∈ p ∧ wn = Widening then (
          if mlup σ x Δ xd = mlup σ x then (
            (mlup σ x, infl, stabl, Set.remove x p', σ, pinfl', post'))
          else (
            let (infl, stabl) = destab x infl stabl in
            iterate x (Set.remove x c⇩w) (insert x c⇩n) infl stabl p' (σ(x ↦ mlup σ x Δ xd)) Narrowing pinfl' post'))
        else
          (mlup σ x, infl, stabl, Set.remove x p', σ, pinfl', post'))
      else (
        let (infl, stabl) = destab x infl stabl in
        let (pinfl', post') = destab_post x post pinfl' post' stabl in
        iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p' (σ(x ↦ d_new)) wn pinfl' post'))
    else
      (mlup σ x, infl, stabl, Set.remove x p, σ, pinfl, post))"
| "eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post = (case t of
      Answer d ⇒ (d, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post)
    | Query y g ⇒ (
        let (yd, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post) = query x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post in
        eval x (g yd) c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post))"
  by pat_completeness auto

definition solve :: "'x ⇒ 'x set × ('x, 'd) map" where
  "solve x = (let (_, _, stabl, _, σ, _, _) =
    iterate x {x} {} fmempty {} {} Map.empty Widening fmempty {} in (stabl, σ))"

definition query_dom where
  "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post =
    query_iterate_eval_dom (Inl (y, x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post))"
declare query_dom_def [simp]
definition iterate_dom where
  "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post =
    query_iterate_eval_dom (Inr (Inl (x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, wn, pinfl, post)))"
declare iterate_dom_def [simp]
definition eval_dom where
  "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post =
    query_iterate_eval_dom (Inr (Inr (x, t, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post)))"
declare eval_dom_def [simp]

definition solve_dom where
  "solve_dom x = iterate_dom x {x} {} fmempty {} {} Map.empty Widening fmempty {}"

lemmas dom_defs = query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def


subsubsection ‹Refinement of auto-generated rules›

text ‹The auto-generated \texttt{pinduct} rule contains a redundant assumption. This lemma removes
this redundant assumption such that the rule is easier to instantiate and gives comprehensible
names to the cases.›

lemmas query_iterate_eval_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Query Iterate Eval]
  = query_iterate_eval.pinduct(1)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post for y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ]
    query_iterate_eval.pinduct(2)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post for x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ]
    query_iterate_eval.pinduct(3)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post for x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ]

lemmas iterate_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Iterate]
  = query_iterate_eval_pinduct(2)[where ?P="λy x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post. True"
    and ?R="λx t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post. True", simplified (no_asm_use),
    folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def]

(* add simps to simp set *)
declare query.psimps [simp]
declare iterate.psimps [simp]
declare eval.psimps [simp]


subsubsection ‹Domain lemmas›

lemma dom_backwards_pinduct:
  shows "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⟹ (c1⇩w, c1⇩n) = (if x ∈ post then (c⇩w, insert x c⇩n) else (insert x c⇩w, c⇩n))
          ⟶ iterate_dom x c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
  and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ⟹ x ∉ stabl ⟹ (eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post) ∧
        ((xd, infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1) =
          eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)
          ⟶ d_new = (if x ∉ p then xd else if wn = Widening then mlup σ1 x ∇ xd else mlup σ1 x Δ xd)
          ⟶ (d_new = mlup σ1 x ⟶ x ∈ p ⟶ wn = Widening ⟶ mlup σ1 x Δ xd ≠ mlup σ1 x ⟶ (infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1
          ⟶ iterate_dom x (Set.remove x c⇩w) (insert x c⇩n) infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1)
          ∧ (d_new ≠ mlup σ1 x
          ⟶ (infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1
          ⟶ (pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2
          ⟶ iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) wn pinfl2 post2)))"
  and "eval_dom x (Query y g) c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (query_dom x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post ∧
        ((yd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post ⟶
          eval_dom x (g yd) c⇩w c⇩n infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'))"
proof (induction y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post and x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    and x "Query y g" c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    arbitrary: c1⇩w c1⇩n and xd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2
    and y g yd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI, goal_cases)
    case 1
    show ?case
      using Query(1) Query(2)[OF Query(3) 1, simplified]
        query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c1⇩w c1⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Widening]
      by fastforce
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)

  have eval_dom: "eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    using Iterate.hyps(2) Iterate.prems query_iterate_eval.domintros(3) by force

  show ?case
  proof (intro impI conjI, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then show ?case using eval_dom by force
  next
    case 2
    have B: "x ∈ p ∧ wn = Widening" using 2(4,5) by simp
    show ?case
      using Iterate.hyps(3)[OF Iterate.prems 2(1) _ _ _ _ _ _ 2(2-3) B 2(6,7), of "(infl1, stabl1,
        p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" p1
        "(σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(pinfl1, post1)" pinfl1 post1 infl2 stabl2, simplified]
        query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of x stabl2 "Set.remove x c⇩w"
        "insert x c⇩n" infl2 p1 "σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd)" pinfl1 post1 Narrowing]
      by fastforce
  next
    case 3
    have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) wn pinfl2 post2"
      using Iterate.hyps(4)[OF Iterate.prems 3(1) _ _ _ _ _ _ 3(2-4) _ 3(5)]
        iterate_dom_def query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl2 c⇩w c⇩n infl2 p1 "σ1(x ↦ d_new)"
        pinfl2 post2 wn]
      by fastforce
    then show ?case by auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  then show ?case using query_iterate_eval.domintros(1,3) by simp
qed


subsubsection ‹Case rules›

lemma iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases[consumes 3]:
  assumes "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') =
          iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post"
    and "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
  obtains (Stable) "x ∈ stabl"
    and "xd = mlup σ x"
    and "infl' = infl"
    and "stabl' = stabl"
    and "p' = Set.remove x p"
    and "σ' = σ"
    and "post' = post"
    and "pinfl' = pinfl"
  | (Fixpoint) p1
  where "x ∉ stabl" and "x ∉ p"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p1, σ', pinfl', post') =
          eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "xd = mlup σ' x"
    and "p' = Set.remove x p1"
  | (W_Fixpoint) xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1
  where "x ∉ stabl" and "x ∈ p" and "wn = Widening"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "(xd1, infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1) =
          eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1 = mlup σ1 x"
    and "mlup σ1 x Δ xd1 ≠ mlup σ1 x"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and "iterate_dom x (Set.remove x c⇩w) (insert x c⇩n) infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') =
          iterate x (Set.remove x c⇩w) (insert x c⇩n) infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1"
  | (N_Fixpoint) xd1 p1
  where "x ∉ stabl" and "x ∈ p" and "wn = Narrowing ∨ (wn = Widening ∧ mlup σ' x ∇ xd1 = mlup σ' x)"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "(xd1, infl', stabl', p1, σ', pinfl', post') =
          eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "mlup σ' x Δ xd1 = xd"
    and "mlup σ' x = xd"
    and "p' = Set.remove x p1"
  | (Continue) xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2
  where "x ∉ stabl"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "(xd1, infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1) =
          eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    and "d_new = (if x ∉ p then xd1 else if wn = Widening then mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1 else mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)"
    and "d_new ≠ mlup σ1 x"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
    and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) wn pinfl2 post2"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') =
          iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) wn pinfl2 post2"
proof(cases "x ∈ stabl" rule: case_split[case_names Stable Unstable])
  case Stable
  then show ?thesis using that(1) assms(1,2) by auto
next
  case Unstable
  then have sldom: "eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
    using assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2) by simp
  then obtain xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1
    where slapp: "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)
      = (xd1, infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
    by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
  then obtain d_new where d_new:
      "d_new = (if x ∉ p then xd1 else if wn = Widening then mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1 else mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)"
    by blast
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "mlup σ1 x = d_new" rule: case_split[case_names Fixpoint Continue])
    case Fixpoint
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "x ∈ p")
      case True
      then show ?thesis
      proof (cases wn)
        case Widening
        show ?thesis
        proof (cases "mlup σ1 x Δ xd1 = mlup σ1 x")
          case True
          have "d_new = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1" using d_new Widening ‹x ∈ p› by simp
          have "iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post = (mlup σ1 x, infl1, stabl1,
              Set.remove x p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
            using assms iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new Widening
              True by auto
          then have "mlup σ1 x = xd" "infl1 = infl'" "stabl1 = stabl'" "Set.remove x p1 = p'"
              "σ1 = σ'" "pinfl1 = pinfl'" "post1 = post'"
            using assms(2)[symmetric] slapp by auto
          then show ?thesis using that(4)[OF Unstable ‹x ∈ p› _ sldom] True slapp
                ‹d_new = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1› Fixpoint Widening by auto
        next
          case False
          obtain infl2 stabl2 where destab: "destab x infl1 stabl1 = (infl2, stabl2)"
            by (cases "destab x infl1 stabl1")
          have "d_new = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1" using d_new Widening True by simp
          moreover have "iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
              = iterate x (Set.remove x c⇩w) (insert x c⇩n) infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1"
            using assms iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new Widening False
              True destab
            by force
          moreover have "iterate_dom x (Set.remove x c⇩w) (insert x c⇩n) infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1"
            using Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new Widening True assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2) destab False
            by auto
          ultimately show ?thesis
            using assms(2) Fixpoint that(3)[OF Unstable True Widening sldom slapp[symmetric]] destab False
            by simp
        qed
      next
        case Narrowing
        have "d_new = mlup σ1 x Δ xd1" using d_new Narrowing True by simp
        moreover have "iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post = (mlup σ1 x, infl1, stabl1,
            Set.remove x p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
          using assms iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new Narrowing
            True
          by fastforce
        ultimately show ?thesis
          using Unstable sldom slapp d_new assms that(4)[OF Unstable True _ sldom] Narrowing Fixpoint
          by auto
      qed
    next
      case False
      have "iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
          = (mlup σ1 x, infl1, stabl1, Set.remove x p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
        using assms iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new False
          by simp
      then show ?thesis
        using Unstable sldom slapp d_new assms that(2)[OF Unstable False sldom] False Fixpoint
        by auto
    qed
  next
    case Continue
    obtain infl2 stabl2 where destab: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
      by (cases "destab x infl1 stabl1") auto
    obtain pinfl2 post2 where post1_def:
        "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
      unfolding destab_post_def
      by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) surj_pair)
    then have dom: "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) wn pinfl2 post2"
      using Unstable Continue slapp d_new assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2) destab by auto
    moreover have "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post')
        = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) wn pinfl2 post2"
      using iterate.psimps assms Unstable slapp d_new Continue destab post1_def
      by (auto simp: Let_def split: prod.splits if_splits)
    ultimately show ?thesis
      using Unstable Continue sldom slapp d_new assms destab that(3,5) post1_def
      by (cases "x ∈ p") auto
  qed
qed

lemma iterate_fmlookup:
  assumes "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') =
          iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post"
    and "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
  shows "mlup σ' x = xd"
  using assms
proof(induction rule: iterate_pinduct)
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)
  show ?case
    using Iterate.hyps Iterate.prems
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case W_Fixpoint
    then show ?thesis
      by (simp add: Iterate.IH Iterate.prems(2))
  next
    case Continue
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2) Iterate.prems(2) by auto
  qed simp+
qed

corollary query_fmlookup:
  assumes "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
  shows "mlup σ' x = xd"
proof -
  obtain c1⇩w c1⇩n where
    c1_def: "(c1⇩w, c1⇩n) = (if x ∈ post then (c⇩w, insert x c⇩n) else (insert x c⇩w, c⇩n))"
    by fastforce
  then show ?thesis
  proof (cases "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n")
    case True
    then have "query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post =
                (mlup σ x, fminsert infl x y, stabl, insert x p, σ, fminsert pinfl x y, post)"
      using assms(1) by auto
    then show ?thesis using assms(2) by simp
  next
    case False
    have idom: "iterate_dom x c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
      using assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(1)[OF assms(1) False] c1_def by simp
    have "query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post =
      (let (xd, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post) = iterate x c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post
       in (xd, fminsert infl x y, stabl, p, σ, fminsert pinfl x y, post))"
      using query.psimps[OF assms(1)[unfolded query_dom_def]] False c1_def by auto
    then obtain infl1 pinfl1 where "(xd, infl1, stabl', p', σ', pinfl1, post') =
        iterate x c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
      "infl' = fminsert infl1 x y" "pinfl' = fminsert pinfl1 x y"
      using assms(2) by (cases "iterate x c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post") simp
    then show ?thesis using iterate_fmlookup[OF idom] c1_def by (auto split: if_splits)
  qed
qed

lemma query_iterate_lookup_cases[consumes 2]:
  assumes "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
  obtains (Iterate) infl1 pinfl1 c1⇩w c1⇩n
  where "x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
    and "iterate_dom x c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl1, stabl', p', σ', pinfl1, post') =
          iterate x c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
    and "(c1⇩w, c1⇩n) = (if x ∈ post then (c⇩w, insert x c⇩n) else (insert x c⇩w, c⇩n))"
    and "infl' = fminsert infl1 x y"
    and "pinfl' = fminsert pinfl1 x y"
  | (Lookup) "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
    and "xd = mlup σ x"
    and "infl' = fminsert infl x y"
    and "stabl' = stabl"
    and "p' = insert x p"
    and "σ' = σ"
    and "post' = post"
    and "pinfl' = fminsert pinfl x y"
  using assms that dom_backwards_pinduct(1)
proof (cases "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n")
  case True
  then show ?thesis using assms that(2) by auto
next
  case False
  obtain c1⇩w c1⇩n where "(c1⇩w, c1⇩n) = (if x ∈ post then (c⇩w, insert x c⇩n) else (insert x c⇩w, c⇩n))"
    by fastforce
  then show ?thesis
    using False assms that(1)[OF False, of c1⇩w c1⇩n] dom_backwards_pinduct(1)[OF assms(1) False]
    by (auto split: prod.splits)
qed

lemma eval_query_answer_cases[consumes 2]:
  assumes "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
  obtains (Query) y g yd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1
  where "t = Query y g"
    and "query_dom x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
    and "(yd, infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1) = query x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) c⇩w c⇩n infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') =
          eval x (g yd) c⇩w c⇩n infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1"
  | (Answer) "t = Answer xd"
    and "infl' = infl"
    and "stabl' = stabl"
    and "p' = p"
    and "σ' = σ"
    and "post' = post"
    and "pinfl' = pinfl"
  using assms dom_backwards_pinduct(3) that
proof (cases t)
  case (Answer _)
  then show ?thesis using assms that by auto
next
  case (Query y g)
  then show ?thesis using assms that dom_backwards_pinduct(3) by (auto split: prod.splits)
qed

end ― ‹end of @{term TD_wn_post} locale›


subsection ‹Partial Correctness›

context TD_wn_post
begin

subsubsection ‹Predicate for valid input state›

abbreviation eq_subsumed :: "('x, 'd) map ⇒ 'x set ⇒ bool" where
  "eq_subsumed σ vars ≡ (∀x ∈ vars. eq T x σ ≤ mlup σ x)"

definition post_invariant where
  "post_invariant c σ infl stabl ≡
    c ⊆ stabl
    ∧ eq_subsumed σ (stabl - c)
    ∧ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl
    ∧ (∀y∈stabl - c. ∀x ∈ dep T σ y. y ∈ slookup infl x)"

lemma post_invariant_simp_c_stabl:
  assumes "x ∈ c"
    and "post_invariant (c - {x}) σ infl stabl"
  shows "post_invariant c σ infl (insert x stabl)"
  using assms
proof -
  have "c - {x} ⊆ stabl ≡ c ⊆ insert x stabl"
    using assms(1)
    by (simp add: subset_insert_iff)
  moreover have "stabl - (c - {x}) ⊇ insert x stabl - c"
    using assms(1)
    by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis
    using assms(2)
    unfolding post_invariant_def
    by (meson subset_iff subset_insertI2)
qed


subsubsection ‹Destabilize and Sigma update preserve invariant›

lemma destab_upd_preserves_part_post_sol:
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and "eq_subsumed σ1 (stabl1 - c)"
    and "∀y∈stabl1 - (c - {x}). ∀x∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup infl1 x"
    and "traverse_rhs (T x) σ1 ≤ xd'"
  shows "eq_subsumed (σ1(x ↦ xd')) (stabl2 - (c - {x}))"
proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
  case (1 y)
  have stabl2_def: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
    using assms(1) destab_infl_stabl_relation by metis
  have x_no_dep: "∀y ∈ stabl2 - (c - {x}). x ∉ dep T σ1 y"
    using destab_x_no_dep[OF assms(1,3)] by simp
  have eq_y_upd: "eq T y (σ1(x ↦ xd')) = eq T y σ1"
    using 1 eq_mupd_no_dep[of x T σ1 y] x_no_dep
    by auto
  show ?case
  proof (cases "y = x")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using assms(4) eq_y_upd unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
  next
    case False
    then have "y ∈ stabl1 - c"
      using 1 stabl2_def by force
    then have "eq T y σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 y"
      using assms(2) by blast
    then show ?thesis using False eq_y_upd unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
  qed
qed

lemma destab_and_upd_preserves_dep_closed_in_infl':
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and "(∀y∈stabl1 - (c - {x}). ∀z∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup infl1 z)"
  shows "(∀y∈stabl2 - (c - {x}). ∀z∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup infl2 z)"
proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
  case (1 z y)
  have infl2_def: "infl2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by infl1 x)) infl1"
    and stabl2_def: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)] by metis+

  have "y ∈ dep T σ1 z" by (simp add: "1"(2))
  then have z_in_infl1_y: "z ∈ slookup infl1 y"
    using 1(1) stabl2_def assms(2) by fastforce

  have "z ∈ influenced_by infl1 y"
    using lookup_in_influenced[of infl1 y] z_in_infl1_y
    by auto
  then have "y ∉ influenced_by infl1 x" and "y ≠ x"
    using stabl2_def 1(1) influenced_by_transitive[of y _ x z] by auto
  then show ?case
    using z_in_infl1_y fmlookup_drop_set infl2_def
    unfolding fmlookup_default_def
    by fastforce
qed

lemma destab_preserves_invariant:
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and "post_invariant c σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
    and "c - {x} ⊆ stabl"
    and "∀y∈dep T σ1 x. x ∈ set (fmlookup_default infl1 [] y)"
    and "eq T x σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 x"
  shows "post_invariant (c - {x}) σ1 infl2 stabl2"
  using assms(2)
  unfolding post_invariant_def
proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
  case 1
  show ?case using subset_trans[OF _ assms(3)] assms(4) by auto
next
  case 2
  have stabl2_def: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
    using assms(1) destab_infl_stabl_relation by metis
  then show ?case using assms(2,6) unfolding post_invariant_def by auto
next
  case 4
  have A: "∀y∈stabl1 - (c - {x}). ∀z∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ set (fmlookup_default infl1 [] z)"
    using 4 assms(5) by auto
  show ?case using destab_and_upd_preserves_dep_closed_in_infl'[OF assms(1) A] by blast
next
  case 3
  then show ?case using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF assms(1)] by auto
qed

lemma destab_upd_preserves_invariant:
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and "post_invariant c σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
    and "c - {x} ⊆ stabl"
    and "traverse_rhs (T x) σ1 ≤ xd'"
    and "∀y∈dep T σ1 x. x ∈ set (fmlookup_default infl1 [] y)"
  shows "post_invariant (c - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ xd')) infl2 stabl2"
  using assms(2)
  unfolding post_invariant_def
proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
  case 1
  show ?case using subset_trans[OF _ assms(3)] assms(4) by auto
next
  case 2
  then have A: "∀y∈stabl1 - (c - {x}). ∀z∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ set (fmlookup_default infl1 [] z)"
    using assms(6) by auto
  then show ?case using destab_upd_preserves_part_post_sol[OF assms(1) _ _ assms(5)] 2 by auto
  case 4
  show ?case using A destab_and_upd_preserves_dep_closed_in_infl[OF assms(1)] by blast
next
  case 3
  then show ?case using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF assms(1)] by auto
qed


subsubsection ‹Post Solution Invariant›

definition "update_rel x infl stabl infl' stabl' σ σ' ≡
    stabl ⊆ stabl' ∧
    (∀u ∈ stabl. slookup infl u ⊆ slookup infl' u) ∧
    (∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {}) ∧
    (∀u ∈ stabl. mlup σ u = mlup σ' u)"


subsubsection ‹Points Invariant›

definition points_inv where
  "points_inv p c infl ≡ p ⊆ c ∧ {u ∈ c. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p"

definition points_inv_upd where
  "points_inv_upd p' p c infl' ≡ points_inv p' c infl' ∧ p ⊆ p'"

lemma add_c_to_point_inv:
  assumes "x ∉ stabl" "x ∈ c" "post_invariant (c - {x}) σ infl stabl"
    "points_inv (p - {x}) (c - {x}) infl"
  shows "points_inv p c infl"
proof -
  have "fmlookup_default infl [] x = []"
    using stabl_infl_empty assms(1,3) unfolding post_invariant_def by force
  then show ?thesis using assms(2,4) unfolding points_inv_def by auto
qed

lemma continue_preserves_pinv:
  assumes "destab x infl1 stabl1 = (infl2, stabl2)"
    and "points_inv p1 c infl1"
  shows "points_inv (p1 - {x}) (c - {x}) infl2"
proof -
  have "{u ∈ c - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1"
  proof
    fix v
    assume A: "v ∈ {u ∈ c - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}}"
    then have "v ∈ c - {x}" and "slookup infl2 v ≠ {}" by auto
    then have "slookup infl1 v ≠ {}"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)[symmetric]]
      by (metis fmlookup_default_drop_set set_empty)
    then show "v ∈ p1" using assms(2) ‹v ∈ c - {x}› unfolding points_inv_def by blast
  qed
  then show "points_inv (p1 - {x}) (c - {x}) infl2" using assms(2) unfolding points_inv_def by auto
qed


subsubsection ‹Narrowing Invariant›

definition narrowing_inv :: "'x set ⇒ ('x,'d) map ⇒ ('x,'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set
  ⇒ ('x,'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ bool" where
  "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl stabl pinfl post ≡
    eq_subsumed σ (post - c⇩w)
    ∧ stabl ⊆ post
    ∧ fset (fmdom pinfl) ⊆ post
    ∧ (∀y∈post - c⇩w. ∀x ∈ dep T σ y. y ∈ slookup pinfl x)
    ∧ (∀u. slookup infl u ⊆ slookup pinfl u)"

lemma dep_x_stabl:
  assumes "fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl"
    and "(∀y∈dep T σ x. x ∈ slookup infl y)"
  shows "dep T σ x ⊆ stabl"
proof
  fix y
  assume "y ∈ dep T σ x"
  then have "slookup infl y ≠ {}" using assms(2) by auto
  then have "fmlookup infl y ≠ None"
    unfolding fmlookup_default_def by (cases "fmlookup infl y") auto
  then show "y ∈ stabl" using assms(1) by force
qed

lemma decr_eq_if_sigma_decr_on_old_deps:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T" and "∀u ∈ dep T σ x. mlup σ' u ≤ mlup σ u"
  shows "eq T x σ' ≤ eq T x σ"
proof -
  define σ⇩c where "σ⇩c = (λe. if e ∈ dep T σ x then σ e else σ' e)"
  have "eq T x σ⇩c = eq T x σ" by (metis σ⇩c_def mlup_def solution_sufficient)
  moreover have "eq T x σ' ≤ eq T x σ⇩c"
  proof -
    have "σ' ⊑⇩m σ⇩c" using assms(2) σ⇩c_def by (auto simp add: mlup_def)
    then show ?thesis using assms(1) unfolding is_mono_eq_def by auto
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis by simp
qed


subsubsection ‹Narrowing Update Relation›

definition update_rel_nar ::
  "'x ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x,'d) map ⇒ ('x,'d) map ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap
  ⇒ ('x, 'x list) fmap ⇒ bool" where
  "update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ' stabl post post' pinfl pinfl' ≡
    post ⊆ post' ∧
    (∀u ∈ post. mlup σ' u ≤ mlup σ u) ∧
    (∀u. slookup pinfl u ⊆ slookup pinfl' u) ∧
    (∀u. (slookup pinfl' u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ (post - (c⇩w ∩ {x})) = {})"
    (* The last condition holds only because dep T σ' u ⊆ dep T σ u for a truly post unknown u and
    and therefore newly collected influences to post unknowns will always be contained in those
    that were already collected previously in pinfl. *)


subsubsection ‹Destabilization Preserves Narrowing Invariant›

lemma subtract_set_preserves_infl_dom_stabl:
  assumes "infl' = fmdrop_set A infl"
    and "stabl' = stabl - B"
    and "B ⊆ A"
    and "fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl"
  shows "fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'"
  using assms by (metis Diff_mono fmdom'_alt_def fmdom'_drop_set)

lemma nar_after_update_if_post:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "mono_deps T"
    and x_post: "x ∈ post"
    and IH: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1"
    and post_inv: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and dep_x_in_infl1: "∀u∈dep T σ1 x. x ∈ slookup infl1 u"
    and d_geq_eq: "eq T x σ1 ≤ d"
    and d_leq_lookup: "d ≤ mlup σ1 x"
    and destab_stabl: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and destab_post: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
  shows "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d)) infl2 stabl2 pinfl2 post2"
  unfolding narrowing_inv_def
proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
  have "post2 = post1" "pinfl2 = pinfl1" using destab_post x_post unfolding destab_post_def by auto

  case 1
  have "σ1(x ↦ d) ⊑⇩m σ1" using d_leq_lookup by (simp add: fun_upd_apply mlup_def)
  then have "eq T u (σ1(x ↦ d)) ≤ eq T u σ1" for u using assms(1) unfolding is_mono_eq_def by simp
  moreover have "eq T u σ1 ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ d)) u" if "u ∈ post1 - (c⇩w - {x})" for u
  proof (cases "u = x")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using d_geq_eq by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
  next
    case False
    then show ?thesis
      using IH that unfolding narrowing_inv_def by (auto simp add: mlup_def fun_upd_other)
  qed
  ultimately show ?case using order_trans ‹post2 = post1› by blast

  case 2
  then have "stabl1 ⊆ post1" using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
  then show ?case using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl] ‹post2 = post1› by blast

  case 3
  have "fset (fmdom pinfl1) ⊆ post1" using IH[unfolded narrowing_inv_def] by simp
  then have "fset (fmdom pinfl1) ⊆ post1" using ‹post2 = post1› by blast
  then show ?case using destab_post destab_post_def x_post by force

  case 4
  show ?case
  proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
    case (1 u v)
    have "σ1(x ↦ d) ⊑⇩m σ1" using d_leq_lookup by (simp add: fun_upd_apply mlup_def)
    then have "dep T (σ1(x ↦ d)) u ⊆ dep T σ1 u" for u
        using ‹mono_deps T› unfolding mono_deps_def by simp
    then have "v ∈ dep T σ1 u" using 1 by blast
    have "u ∈ slookup pinfl1 v"
    proof -
      have "∀y∈post2 - (c⇩w - {x}). ∀x∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup pinfl1 x"
        using IH[unfolded narrowing_inv_def] dep_x_in_infl1 ‹post2 = post1› by blast
      then have "∀x∈dep T σ1 u. u ∈ slookup pinfl1 x" using 1(1) by simp
      then show ?thesis using ‹v ∈ dep T σ1 u› by blast
    qed
    then show ?case using destab_post destab_post_def x_post by force
  qed

  case 5
  have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u" for u
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl]
    by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
  moreover have "stabl2 ⊆ stabl1"
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl] by auto
  ultimately show ?case
    using ‹pinfl2 = pinfl1› IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
qed

lemma lookup_in_influenced_cutoff:
  assumes "x ∉ stabl"
  shows "slookup pinfl x ⊆ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl x stabl"
proof(intro subsetI, goal_cases)
  case (1 y)
  then show ?case
    using influenced_by_cutoff.base[of x stabl pinfl] assms
    by (cases rule: set_fmlookup_default_cases) simp
qed

lemma inf_infl_inf_cutoff_infl_or_stabl:
  assumes "u ∈ influenced_by infl1 x"
    and "x ∈ stabl1"
    and stabl2: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
    and "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1"
    and "x ∉ stabl2"
  shows "u ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x stabl2 - stabl2"
  using assms(1)
proof (induction rule: influenced_by.induct[consumes 1, case_names base step])
  case (base ys y)
  then have "y ∈ slookup pinfl1 x" using assms(2,5) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by fastforce
  then have "y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x stabl2" if "x ∉ stabl2"
    using lookup_in_influenced_cutoff that by fastforce
  moreover have "y ∉ stabl2"
    using influenced_by.base base.hyps(1) base.hyps(2) stabl2 assms(1) by fast
  ultimately show ?case using assms(6) by blast
next
  case (step y zs z)
  have "y ∈ stabl1"
    using assms(4) step(2,3) unfolding post_invariant_def by (meson fmdomI subsetD)
  then have "z ∈ slookup pinfl1 y"
    using step(2,3) assms(5) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by fastforce

  have "y ∉ stabl2" using step(1) stabl2 by simp
  then have "y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x stabl2" if "x ∉ stabl2"
    using step(4) that by blast
  then have "z ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x stabl2" if "x ∉ stabl2"
    using ‹y ∉ stabl2› that influenced_by_cutoff.step[of y pinfl1 x stabl2] ‹z ∈ slookup pinfl1 y›
    by (meson set_fmlookup_default_cases)

  moreover have "z ∉ stabl2" by (metis DiffD2 influenced_by.step stabl2 step.hyps(1-3))

  ultimately show ?case using assms(6) by blast
qed

lemma u_not_dep_on_x:
  assumes destab_stabl_res_2: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
    and destab_post_res_2: "post2 = post1 - (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)"
    and x_not_post: "x ∉ post"
    and post_inv: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) σ infl stabl"
    and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
    and update_rel_nar: "update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 stabl post post1 pinfl pinfl1"
    and post_inv1: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and nar_inv1: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1"
    and dep_x_infl1: "∀y ∈ dep T σ1 x. x ∈ slookup infl1 y"
    and x_no_dep: "x ∈ stabl2 ⟶ x ∉ dep T σ1 x"
    and u_in_post2: "u ∈ post2 - (c⇩w - {x})"
  shows "x ∉ dep T σ1 u"
proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
  case 1
  then have "u ∈ slookup infl1 x" if "u ∈ stabl1 - (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n)"
    using post_inv1 that nar_inv1 unfolding post_invariant_def narrowing_inv_def by blast

  have "u ∈ post1 - c⇩w" using u_in_post2
    using 1 dep_x_infl1 destab_post_res_2 lookup_in_influenced_cutoff x_no_dep nar_inv1
    unfolding narrowing_inv_def by force
  then have "u ∈ slookup pinfl1 x" using nar_inv1 1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
  then have u_in_cutoff_if_x_stabl: "u ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})"
    using lookup_in_influenced_cutoff[of x "stabl2 - {x}" pinfl1] by fast
  have u_notin_cutoff: "u ∉ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2"
    using destab_post_res_2 u_in_post2 by blast
  then have "u ∈ stabl2" using u_in_cutoff_if_x_stabl by blast
  have "u ≠ x"
  proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then have "x ∈ dep T σ1 x" using ‹¬ x ∉ dep T σ1 u› by simp
    then have "x ∈ slookup infl1 x" using dep_x_infl1 by fastforce
    then have "x ∈ influenced_by infl1 x" using lookup_in_influenced by fastforce
    then have "x ∉ stabl2" using destab_stabl_res_2 by auto
    then show ?case using "1" u_in_cutoff_if_x_stabl u_notin_cutoff by blast
  qed
  have "u ∈ stabl1" using ‹u ∈ stabl2› destab_stabl_res_2 by blast
  have "u ∈ c⇩n"
  proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then have "u ∈ stabl1 - (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n)" using u_in_post2 ‹u ≠ x› ‹u ∈ stabl1› by blast
    then have "u ∈ slookup infl1 x"
      using post_inv1[unfolded post_invariant_def] ‹¬ x ∉ dep T σ1 u› by blast
    then have "u ∈ influenced_by infl1 x" using lookup_in_influenced by fastforce
    then have "u ∉ stabl2" using destab_stabl_res_2 by simp
    then show False using ‹u ∈ stabl2› by auto
  qed
  then have "u ∈ stabl"
    using ‹u ≠ x› post_inv unfolding post_invariant_def by blast
  have "slookup pinfl x = {}"
    using nar_inv x_not_post stabl_infl_empty unfolding narrowing_inv_def by metis
  then have "u ∉ post - {x}"
    using update_rel_nar ‹u ∈ slookup pinfl1 x› unfolding update_rel_nar_def by fastforce
  then have "u ∉ stabl - {x}" using nar_inv unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
  then have "False" using ‹u ∈ stabl› ‹u ≠ x› by blast
  then show ?case by simp
qed


lemma non_post_not_influenced:
  assumes "u ∈ influenced_by pinfl1 x"
    and x_not_post: "x ∉ post"
    and lookup_diff: "∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ (post - {x}) = {}"
    and pinfl_subset_post: "fset (fmdom pinfl) ⊆ post"
  shows "u ∉ post"
    using assms(1)
proof (induction rule: influenced_by.induct[consumes 1, case_names base step])
  case (base ys y)
  have "slookup pinfl x = {}" using x_not_post pinfl_subset_post stabl_infl_empty by simp
  then have "∀u ∈ slookup pinfl1 x. u ∉ post - {x}" using lookup_diff by fastforce
  then have "y ∉ post - {x}" using base by simp
  then show ?case using x_not_post by simp
next
  case (step y zs z)
  have "slookup pinfl y = {}" using pinfl_subset_post step(4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def
    by (meson stabl_infl_empty)
  then have "z ∈ slookup pinfl1 y - slookup pinfl y" by (simp add: step.hyps(2) step.hyps(3))
  then show ?case using lookup_diff x_not_post by blast
qed

lemma nar_inv_after_destab_update_if_not_post:
  assumes x_not_post: "x ∉ post"
    and post_inv: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) σ infl stabl"
    and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
    and post_inv1: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and nar_inv1: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1"
    and update_rel: "update_rel x infl (insert x stabl) infl1 stabl1 σ σ1"
    and update_rel_nar: "update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 stabl post post1 pinfl pinfl1"
    and destab_post: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
    and destab_stabl: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and x_stabl1: "x ∈ stabl1"
    and xd1_def: "eq T x σ1 ≤ d"
    and x_no_dep: "x ∈ stabl2 ⟶ x ∉ dep T σ1 x"
    and dep_x_infl1: "∀y ∈ dep T σ1 x. x ∈ slookup infl1 y"
    and dom_subset: "post ⊆ post1"
    and stabl_subset: "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
    and post_inv2: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d)) infl2 stabl2"
    and c_post_rel: "(x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post - stabl) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post)"
    and xcalled: "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
    and called_dist: "c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}"
  shows "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d)) infl2 stabl2 pinfl2 post2"
proof -
  have destab_post': "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_barrier x pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
    using destab_post x_not_post unfolding destab_post_def by auto
  then have destab_post_res:
    "pinfl2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})) - stabl2) pinfl1"
    "post2 = post1 - (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)"
    unfolding destab_barrier_def by (auto split: prod.splits)

  have destab_stabl_res: "infl2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by infl1 x)) infl1"
    "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
    using destab_stabl destab_infl_stabl_relation[of infl2 stabl2 x infl1 stabl1] by auto

  have stabl_subset_post2: "stabl2 ⊆ post2"
  proof -
    have "stabl1 ⊆ post1" using nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by simp
    then show ?thesis using destab_post_res(2) destab_stabl_res(2) by auto
  qed

  show ?thesis
    unfolding narrowing_inv_def
  proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
    have dom_subset_2: "post ⊆ post1" using dom_subset by auto

    case 2
    then show ?case using stabl_subset_post2 by auto

    case 1
    have "eq T u σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 u" if "u ∈ post1 - c⇩w" for u
      using nar_inv1[unfolded narrowing_inv_def] that by simp
    have "eq T u σ1 ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ d)) u" if "x ≠ u" "u ∈ post1 - (c⇩w - {x})" for u
      using that ‹⋀u. u ∈ post1 - c⇩w ⟹ eq T u σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 u›
        by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
    moreover have "eq T x σ1 ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ d)) x"
    proof -
      have "eq T x σ1 ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ d)) x"
        using nar_inv1 xd1_def by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
      then show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same)
    qed
    moreover have "eq T u (σ1(x ↦ d)) = eq T u σ1" if "u ∈ post2 - (c⇩w - {x})" for u
    proof -
      have "x ∉ dep T σ1 u"
        using u_not_dep_on_x destab_stabl_res(2) destab_post_res(2) x_not_post post_inv dep_x_infl1
          nar_inv nar_inv1 post_inv1 that update_rel_nar x_no_dep by blast
      then show ?thesis using eq_mupd_no_dep by force
    qed
    ultimately show ?case using destab_post_res(2) dom_subset by (metis Diff_iff)
  next
    case 3
    show ?case
      using nar_inv1 subtract_set_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF destab_post_res]
      unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
  next
    case 4
    have "∀y∈post1 - (c⇩w - {x}). ∀x∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup pinfl1 x"
      using nar_inv1 dep_x_infl1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
    show ?case
    proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
      case (1 y z)
      have "x ∉ dep T σ1 y"
        using u_not_dep_on_x destab_stabl_res(2) destab_post_res(2) dep_x_infl1 nar_inv nar_inv1
          post_inv post_inv1 update_rel_nar x_no_dep x_not_post 1(1) by blast
      then have "dep T (σ1(x ↦ d)) y = dep T σ1 y" by (metis dep_eq mlup_eq_mupd_set)
      then have "z ∈ dep T σ1 y" using 1(2) by blast
      then have "y ∈ slookup pinfl1 z"
      proof -
        have "∀y∈post1 - (c⇩w - {x}). ∀x∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup pinfl1 x"
          using nar_inv1 dep_x_infl1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
        moreover have "y ∈ post1 - (c⇩w - {x})" using "1"(1) destab_post_res(2) by blast
        ultimately show ?thesis using ‹z ∈ dep T σ1 y› by blast
      qed
      have "z ≠ x" using ‹z ∈ dep T σ1 y› ‹x ∉ dep T σ1 y› by auto

      have "z ∈ post1" using ‹y ∈ slookup pinfl1 z› nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def
        by (metis stabl_infl_empty empty_iff)
      have "y ∈ post1" using "1"(1) destab_post_res(2) by blast

      have "z ∉ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2"
      proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then have "z ∉ stabl2" "z ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})" by auto
        then have "y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})"
          using influenced_by_cutoff.step[of z pinfl1 x "stabl2 - {x}"] ‹y ∈ slookup pinfl1 z›
          by (meson Diff_iff set_fmlookup_default_cases)
        with ‹y ∈ post2 - (c⇩w - {x})› have "y ∈ stabl2" using destab_post_res(2) by blast
        have "y ∉ stabl2 - (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x})"
        proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
          case 1
          then have "dep T σ1 y ⊆ stabl2"
            using post_inv2 dep_subset_stable ‹dep T (σ1(x ↦ d)) y = dep T σ1 y›
            unfolding post_invariant_def by blast
          then have "z ∈ stabl2" using ‹z ∈ dep T σ1 y› by auto
          then show ?case using ‹z ∉ stabl2› by simp
        qed
        then have "y ∈ c⇩n" "y ≠ x" "y ∉ c⇩w" using ‹y ∈ post2 - (c⇩w - {x})› ‹y ∈ stabl2› by auto
        then have "y ∈ stabl" using post_inv unfolding post_invariant_def by auto
        then have "y ∈ post" using nar_inv unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
        then have "y ∈ slookup pinfl z"
          using ‹y ∈ slookup pinfl1 z› ‹y ∈ post› ‹y ∉ c⇩w› ‹y ≠ x› update_rel_nar
          unfolding update_rel_nar_def by blast
        then have "z ∈ post"
          using nar_inv stabl_infl_empty[of z post pinfl] unfolding narrowing_inv_def
          by fastforce
        have "y ∈ influenced_by pinfl1 x"
          using influenced_cutoff_subset
            ‹y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})› by fastforce
        have "x ∈ c⇩w" using c_post_rel x_not_post xcalled called_dist by blast
        have "y ∉ post"
          using non_post_not_influenced[OF ‹y ∈ influenced_by pinfl1 x› x_not_post] nar_inv
            update_rel_nar ‹x ∈ c⇩w› unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def by auto
        then show False using ‹y ∈ post› by blast
      qed
      then have "z ∉ insert x (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})) - stabl2"
        using ‹z ≠ x› by blast
      then have "slookup pinfl1 z = slookup pinfl2 z" using destab_post_res(1)
        by (simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set)
      then show ?case using ‹y ∈ slookup pinfl1 z› by simp
    qed
  next
    case 5
    then show ?case
    proof (intro allI, goal_cases)
      case (1 u)
      then show ?case
      proof (cases "u ∈ stabl2")
        case True
        have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u"
          using destab_stabl_res(1) fmlookup_default_drop_set
          by (metis empty_iff empty_set subset_iff)
        moreover have "slookup pinfl2 u = slookup pinfl1 u"
          using destab_post_res(1) True fmlookup_default_drop_set
          by (metis Diff_iff)
        ultimately show ?thesis using nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
      next
        case False
        then have "slookup infl2 u = {}"
          using stabl_infl_empty post_inv2 post_invariant_def by metis
        then show ?thesis by simp
      qed
      
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma post_dom_incr:
  assumes IH1: "insert x post ⊆ post1"
    and post_inv: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) σ infl stabl"
    and post_inv1: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
    and nar_inv1: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1"
    and update_rel_nar: "update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 (insert x stabl) (insert x post) post1 pinfl pinfl1"
    and post3_def: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
    and post_and_c: "(x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post - stabl) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post)"
    and called_disj: "c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}"
    and xcalled: "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
    and x_not_stabl: "x ∉ stabl"
  shows "post ⊆ post2"
proof (cases "x ∈ post")
  case True
  then have "post2 = post1" using post3_def unfolding destab_post_def by simp
  then show ?thesis using IH1 by simp
next
  case False
  then have destab: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_barrier x pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
    using post3_def unfolding destab_post_def
    by (cases "destab_barrier x pinfl1 post1 stabl2") auto

  have "x ∉ fset (fmdom pinfl)" using nar_inv False unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
  then have "slookup pinfl x = {}" by (simp add: stabl_infl_empty)
  then have "influenced_by pinfl x = {}"
    by (metis influenced_by_aux UN_E empty_iff equals0I)

  have post2_sub: "post ⊆ post1 - {x}" using IH1 False by blast
  have destab_post: "post2 = post1 - (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)"
    using destab unfolding destab_barrier_def by simp

  have "x ∈ c⇩w" using False post_and_c called_disj xcalled by blast
  then have U: "∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ (post - {x}) = {}"
    using update_rel_nar False unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp
  have "u ∉ post" if "u ∈ influenced_by pinfl1 x" for u
    using that
  proof (induction rule: influenced_by.induct[consumes 1, case_names base step])
    case (base ys y)
    have "∀u ∈ slookup pinfl1 x. u ∉ post - {x}" using U ‹slookup pinfl x = {}› by fastforce
    then have "y ∉ post - {x}" using base by simp
    then show ?case using False by simp
  next
    case (step y zs z)
    have "slookup pinfl y = {}" using nar_inv step(4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def
      by (meson stabl_infl_empty)
    then have "z ∈ slookup pinfl1 y - slookup pinfl y" by (simp add: step.hyps(2) step.hyps(3))
    then show ?case using U False by blast
  qed

  moreover have "influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x}) ⊆ influenced_by pinfl1 x"
    by (meson influenced_cutoff_subset)

  ultimately show ?thesis using post2_sub destab_post by blast
qed

lemma c_post_after_destab:
  assumes "(x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post - stabl) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post)"
    and "c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}"
    and "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
    and "x ∉ stabl"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
    and "post ⊆ post2"
    and "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
    and "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1"
  shows "(x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post2 - stabl2) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post2)"
proof (cases "x ∈ c⇩w")
  case True
  then have "x ∉ post" using assms(1,4) by simp
  have "x ∉ post2 - stabl2"
  proof -
    have "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_barrier x pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
      using assms(6) ‹x ∉ post› unfolding destab_post_def by simp
    then have post2: "post2 = post1 - (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)"
      and stabl2: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation assms(5) unfolding destab_barrier_def by fast+
    have "influenced_by pinfl x = {}" using assms(8) unfolding narrowing_inv_def
      by (metis Diff_disjoint Diff_empty influenced_by_aux stabl_infl_empty
          UN_E ‹x ∉ post› disjoint_iff equals0I)
    have "x ∈ stabl1" using assms(3,9) unfolding post_invariant_def by auto
    then have "u ∈ influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x stabl2 - stabl2 ∨ x ∈ stabl2"
      if "u ∈ influenced_by infl1 x" for u
      using inf_infl_inf_cutoff_infl_or_stabl that assms(9,10) stabl2 by force
    then show ?thesis using post2 stabl2 assms(3,9) unfolding post_invariant_def by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis using True assms(2) by blast
next
  case False
  then have "x ∈ c⇩n" and "x ∈ post" using assms(1,3) by auto
  then show ?thesis using assms(7) False by auto
qed

lemma infl_diff_eval_step_2:
  assumes "stabl ⊆ stabl1"
    and "∀ξ. (slookup infl' ξ - slookup infl1 ξ) ∩ stabl1 = {}"
    and "∀ξ. (slookup infl1 ξ - slookup infl ξ) ∩ stabl = {}"
  shows "∀ξ. (slookup infl' ξ - slookup infl ξ) ∩ stabl = {}"
proof(intro allI, goal_cases)
  case (1 ξ)
  have "((slookup infl' ξ - slookup infl1 ξ)
          ∪ (slookup infl1 ξ - slookup infl ξ)) ∩ stabl = {}"
    using assms by auto
  then show ?case by blast
qed

lemma narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post:
  assumes xcalled: "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
      and wn_post: "(x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post - stabl) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post)"
      and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
    shows "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
proof -
  show ?thesis using wn_post nar_inv xcalled unfolding narrowing_inv_def
    by auto
qed

lemma post_inv_after_destab:
  assumes Continue4: " d_new = (if x ∉ p then xd1 else if wn = Widening then mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1 else mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)"
    and Continue6: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
    and Iterate_prems3: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) σ infl stabl"
    and Iterate_prems7: "x ∉ p ⟶ wn = Widening"
    and stabl_inc: "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
    and post1_x: "x ∈ post ⟶ eq T x σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 x"
    and in_post_N: "wn = Narrowing ⟶ x ∈ post"
    and post_inv1: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1"
    and update_rel1: "update_rel x infl stabl infl1 stabl1 σ σ1"
    and eq_x: "eq T x σ1 = xd1"
    and dep_x: "(∀y∈dep_aux σ1 (T x). x ∈ slookup infl1 y)"
    and x_no_dep: "⋀y. y ∈ stabl2 - ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) ⟶ x ∉ dep T σ1 y"
  shows "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) infl2 stabl2"
    unfolding post_invariant_def update_rel_nar_def
proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
  case 1
  define σ2 where [simp]: "σ2 = σ1(x ↦ xd1)"
  show ?case using stabl_inc
    by (meson Iterate_prems3 dual_order.trans post_invariant_def)
  case 2
  have infl_closed: "(∀x∈stabl1 - ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}). ∀y∈dep T σ1 x. x ∈ slookup infl1 y)"
    using post_inv1 dep_x unfolding post_invariant_def dep_def by auto
  have "eq T x σ1 ≤ d_new"
  proof (cases wn)
    case Widening
    then show ?thesis using widening_ge Continue4 eq_x by simp
  next
    case Narrowing
    then have "x ∈ p" using Iterate_prems7 by blast
    then have "d_new = mlup σ1 x Δ eq T x σ1" using Continue4 eq_x Narrowing by simp
    then have "mlup σ1 x ⊓ eq T x σ1 ≤ d_new" using narrowing_ge by simp
    then show ?thesis using inf_absorb2 post1_x in_post_N Narrowing by fastforce
  qed
  then show ?case
    using destab_upd_preserves_part_post_sol[OF Continue6 _ infl_closed, of d_new] post_inv1
    unfolding eq_def post_invariant_def by auto
  case 3
  show ?case
    using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF Continue6] post_inv1 unfolding post_invariant_def
    by auto
  case 4
  show ?case
  proof(intro ballI, goal_cases)
    case (1 y z)
    have "dep T σ1 y = dep T σ2 y" using x_no_dep 1(1) dep_eq[of T σ1 _ σ2] σ2_def fun_upd_apply
      unfolding mlup_def by metis
    then show ?case
      using 1 destab_and_upd_preserves_dep_closed_in_infl infl_closed Continue6
      by metis
  qed
qed

lemma narrow_inv_after_destab:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T" "mono_deps T"
      and Continue4: "d_new = (if x ∉ p then xd1 else if wn = Widening then mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1 else mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)"
      and Continue5: "d_new ≠ mlup σ1 x"
      and Continue6: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
      and Continue7: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
      and Iterate2: "(x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post - stabl) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post)"
      and Iterate3: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) σ infl stabl"
      and Iterate5: "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
      and Iterate6: "wn = Narrowing ⟶ x ∈ c⇩n"
      and Iterate7: "x ∉ p ⟶ wn = Widening"
      and post1_x: "x ∈ post ⟶ eq T x σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 x"
      and stabl_inc: "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
      and x_no_dep: "⋀y. y ∈ stabl2 - ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) ⟶ x ∉ dep T σ1 y"
      and xcalled: "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
      and called_dist: "c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}"
      and inv: "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) infl2 stabl2"
      and IH: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1 ∧
          update_rel x infl (insert x stabl) infl1 stabl1 σ σ1 ∧
          narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1 ∧
          update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 (insert x stabl) (insert x post) post1 pinfl pinfl1 ∧
          traverse_rhs (T x) σ1 = xd1 ∧ (∀y∈dep_aux σ1 (T x). x ∈ slookup infl1 y)"
    shows "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) infl2 stabl2 pinfl2 post2"
proof (cases "x ∈ post")
  case True
  have d_new_leq: "eq T x σ1 ≤ d_new"
  proof (cases wn)
    case Widening
    then show ?thesis using Continue4 IH widening_ge by auto
  next
    case Narrowing
    then have "mlup σ1 x ⊓ eq T x σ1 ≤ d_new" using Continue4 IH narrowing_ge by auto
    then show ?thesis using inf.absorb2 post1_x True by fastforce
  qed
  have d_new_geq: "d_new ≤ mlup σ1 x"
  proof (cases wn)
    case Widening
    then show ?thesis using Continue4 Continue5 IH widening_bounded True post1_x by force
  next
    case Narrowing
    then show ?thesis using Continue4 IH narrowing_le Iterate7 by simp
  qed

  have "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) infl2 stabl2 pinfl2 post2"
    using nar_after_update_if_post[OF assms(1,2) True _ _ _ d_new_leq d_new_geq
        Continue6] IH Continue7 unfolding destab_post_def by (metis dep_def)
  then show ?thesis using True Continue5 unfolding destab_post_def by simp
next
  case False
  then have "wn = Widening" using Iterate2 Iterate6 called_dist by (cases wn) auto
  then have "eq T x σ1 ≤ d_new"
  proof (cases "x ∈ p")
    case True
    then have "d_new = mlup σ1 x ∇ eq T x σ1" using Continue4 IH ‹wn = Widening› by simp
    then show ?thesis using widening_ge by auto
  next
    case False
    then have "d_new = xd1" using Continue4 IH by simp
    then show ?thesis using IH by auto 
  qed
    
  moreover have "x ∉ dep T σ1 x" if "x ∈ stabl2"
    using that x_no_dep by auto
  moreover have "update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 stabl post post1 pinfl pinfl1"
  proof -
    have "update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 (insert x stabl) (insert x post) post1 pinfl pinfl1"
      using IH by simp
    then show ?thesis using IH xcalled unfolding update_rel_nar_def by blast
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis
    using nar_inv_after_destab_update_if_not_post[OF False Iterate3 Iterate5 _ _ _ _
        Continue7 Continue6] IH[folded dep_def] stabl_inc inv Iterate2 xcalled called_dist
    unfolding update_rel_nar_def update_rel_def by auto
qed


subsubsection ‹Partial Correctness Induction Proof›

lemma partial_correctness_ind:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
      and "mono_deps T"
    shows "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ infl stabl
      ⟹ points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl
      ⟹ narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl stabl pinfl post
      ⟹ c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}
      ⟹ y ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
      ⟹ x ∈ dep T σ y
      ⟹ post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ' infl' stabl'
        ∧ update_rel y infl stabl infl' stabl' σ σ'
        ∧ points_inv_upd p' p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl'
        ∧ narrowing_inv c⇩w σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post'
        ∧ update_rel_nar y c⇩w σ σ' stabl post post' pinfl pinfl'
        ∧ y ∈ slookup infl' x"
      and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
      ⟹ (x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post - stabl) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post)
      ⟹ post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) σ infl stabl
      ⟹ points_inv (p - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl
      ⟹ narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post
      ⟹ (wn = Narrowing) ⟶ (x ∈ c⇩n)
      ⟹ x ∉ p ⟶ wn = Widening
      ⟹ c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}
      ⟹ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
      ⟹ post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) σ' infl' stabl'
        ∧ update_rel x infl stabl infl' stabl' σ σ'
        ∧ points_inv_upd p' (p - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl'
        ∧ narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post'
        ∧ update_rel_nar x (c⇩w - {x}) σ σ' stabl post post' pinfl pinfl'
        ∧ x ∈ stabl'"
      and "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
      ⟹ post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ infl stabl
      ⟹ points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl
      ⟹ narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl stabl pinfl post
      ⟹ c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}
      ⟹ subt_for_prefix (T x) pre σ = Some t
      ⟹ set pre ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ' infl' stabl'
        ∧ update_rel x infl stabl infl' stabl' σ σ'
        ∧ points_inv_upd p' p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl'
        ∧ narrowing_inv c⇩w σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post'
        ∧ update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ' stabl post post' pinfl pinfl'
        ∧ traverse_rhs t σ' = xd
        ∧ (∀y∈dep_aux σ' t. x ∈ slookup infl' y)"
proof(induction y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post and x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    and y t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    arbitrary: xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post' and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post' pre
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate infl1 pinfl1 c1⇩w c1⇩n)
    have T: "x ∉ p" using Query.prems(3) Iterate(1) unfolding points_inv_def by auto
    then have S: "post_invariant (c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x}) σ infl stabl"
      using Query.prems(2) Iterate(1,4) by (auto split: if_splits)
    have Q: "x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using Iterate(1) by simp
    have T: "x ∈ post ∧ x ∈ p ∧ x ∉ stabl ⟶ Widening = Narrowing" using T by fastforce
    have R: "narrowing_inv (c1⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
      using Query.prems(4) ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› Iterate(4) by (auto split: if_splits)
    have Widening: "points_inv (p - {x}) (c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x}) infl"
      using Query.prems(3) ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› ‹x ∉ p› Iterate(4) by (auto split: if_splits)
    have "(x ∉ post) = (x ∈ c1⇩w) ∧ (x ∈ post) = (x ∈ c1⇩n)"
      using ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› Iterate(4) Query.prems(2) unfolding post_invariant_def
      by (auto split: if_splits)
    have T2: "(x ∈ c1⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post - stabl) ∧ (x ∈ c1⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post)"
      using ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› Iterate(4) Query.prems(2) unfolding post_invariant_def
      by (auto split: if_splits)
    have "c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using Iterate(4) ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› by (auto split: if_splits)
    have "c1⇩w - {x} = c⇩w" and "c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩n"
      using Iterate(4) ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› by (auto split: if_splits)
    have U: "c1⇩w ∩ c1⇩n = {}" using Iterate(1,4) Query.prems by (auto split: if_splits)
    have V: "x ∈ c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n" using Iterate(4) by (auto split: if_splits)
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[OF Q Iterate(4) _ Iterate(3) T2 S Widening R _ _ U V, simplified]
    then show ?thesis using Iterate
    proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      show ?case using 1(1,6) ‹c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n›
        unfolding post_invariant_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def by auto
    next
      case 2
      show ?case using 2 unfolding update_rel_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 3
        have "∀ξ. (slookup infl1 ξ - slookup infl ξ) ∩ stabl = {}"
          using 2(1,3,4) Query.prems(2)[unfolded post_invariant_def] unfolding update_rel_def
          by (cases "x ∈ stabl") fastforce+
        then show ?case using 2 infl_upd_diff[of infl1 infl stabl x] by auto
      qed (auto simp add: fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def)
    next
      case 3
      show ?case using 3 unfolding points_inv_def points_inv_upd_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case using ‹c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› by auto
      next
        case 2
        have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
        proof
          fix v
          assume "v ∈ {u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}}"
          then have "v ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" and "slookup (fminsert infl1 x y) v ≠ {}"
            using ‹c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› Iterate(5) by auto
          then have "slookup infl1 v ≠ {}"
            using ‹v ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› unfolding fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
            by (metis fmupd_lookup)
          then show "v ∈ p'"
            using ‹v ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› ‹x ∉ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› IH ‹c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n›
            unfolding points_inv_def points_inv_upd_def
            by blast
        qed
        then show ?case using IH ‹c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› unfolding points_inv_def by auto
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case using IH ‹x ∉ p› by simp
      qed
    next
      case 4
      then have "narrowing_inv (c1⇩w - {x}) σ' infl1 stabl' pinfl1 post'" by simp
      then show ?case unfolding narrowing_inv_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 3
        have "x ∈ stabl'" using IH unfolding post_invariant_def by simp
        then have "x ∈ post'" using 3 Iterate(1) by auto
        moreover have "fset (fmdom infl') = fset (fmdom infl1) ∪ {x}"
          using Iterate(5) unfolding fminsert_def by simp
        ultimately show ?case by (simp add: "3" Iterate(6) fminsert_def)
      next
        case 4
        show ?case
          using 4 ‹c1⇩w - {x} = c⇩w›
          by (metis Iterate(6) UnCI slookup_fminsert_other slookup_fminsert_same)
      next
        case 5
        show ?case
        proof (intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 u)
          then show ?case using Iterate(5,6) IH 1 5
            by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
        qed
      qed (auto simp add: ‹c1⇩w - {x} = c⇩w›)
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case by blast
      next
        case 2
        then show ?case by blast
      next
        case 3
        have "slookup pinfl1 v ⊆ slookup pinfl' v" for v
          using Iterate(6) unfolding fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def by auto
        then show ?case using 3 by blast
      next
        case 4
        then have A: "∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ post = {}" by blast
        then have B: "∀u. (slookup (fminsert pinfl1 x y) u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ (post - {y}) = {}"
          by (simp add: infl_upd_diff)
        then show ?case
        proof (cases "y ∈ c⇩w")
          case True
          then show ?thesis using B Iterate(6) by simp
        next
          case False
          then have "y ∈ c⇩n" using Query.prems(5,6) by auto
          then have "x ∈ dep T σ y" using Query.prems(7) by simp
          then have "y ∈ slookup pinfl x"
          proof -
            have "y ∈ post - c⇩w"
              using Query.prems(2,4,5) ‹y ∈ c⇩n› unfolding post_invariant_def narrowing_inv_def
              by auto
            then show ?thesis
              using Query.prems(4) ‹x ∈ dep T σ y› unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
          qed
          have "x ∈ post"
          proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
            case 1
            then have "slookup pinfl x = {}"
              using Query.prems(4) stabl_infl_empty unfolding narrowing_inv_def by metis
            then show ?case using ‹y ∈ slookup pinfl x› by simp
          qed
          then have "y ∈ slookup pinfl1 x"
            using IH ‹y ∈ slookup pinfl x› ‹x ∈ post› unfolding update_rel_nar_def by blast
          then have "slookup (fminsert pinfl1 x y) u = slookup pinfl1 u" for u
            by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
          then have "∀u. (slookup (fminsert pinfl1 x y) u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ post = {}"
            using ‹∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ post = {}› by blast
          then show ?thesis using False Iterate(6) by blast
        qed
      qed
    qed (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(2)
    proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1 then show ?case unfolding post_invariant_def
        by (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
    next case 3
      have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
        using Query.prems(3) Lookup(3,5) unfolding fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def points_inv_def
        by auto
      then show ?case
        using Query.prems(3) 3(1,3,5) unfolding points_inv_def points_inv_upd_def by auto
    next
      case 4
      then show ?case
        using Lookup(1,8) Query.prems(4) unfolding post_invariant_def narrowing_inv_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 5
        then show ?case
        proof (intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 u)
          show ?case
          proof (cases "u = x")
            case True
            then show ?thesis
              by (metis "1"(12) "5"(12) Diff_insert_absorb Lookup(3,8)
                  Un_mono diff_shunt insert_absorb insert_not_empty slookup_fminsert_same)
          next
            case False
            then show ?thesis
              by (metis "1"(12) "5"(12) Lookup(3,8) slookup_fminsert_other)
          qed
        qed
      qed (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 4
        then show ?case
        proof (cases "y ∈ c⇩w")
          case True
          then show ?thesis using 4 by (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
        next
          case False
          then have "y ∈ c⇩n" using Query.prems(5,6) by auto
          then have "x ∈ dep T σ y" using Query.prems(7) by simp
          then have "y ∈ slookup pinfl x"
          proof -
            have "y ∈ post - c⇩w"
              using Query.prems(2,4,5) ‹y ∈ c⇩n› unfolding post_invariant_def narrowing_inv_def
              by auto
            then show ?thesis using Query.prems(4) ‹x ∈ dep T σ y› unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
          qed
          then have "slookup (fminsert pinfl x y) u = slookup pinfl u" for u
            by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
          then show ?thesis using False Lookup(8) by blast
        qed
      qed (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
    qed (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def update_rel_def)
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)
  have xstabl: "x ∈ insert x stabl" by simp
  have xcalled: "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using Iterate.prems(9) by simp
  have called_dist: "c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}" using Iterate.prems(8) by simp
  have inv: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ infl (insert x stabl)"
    using post_invariant_simp_c_stabl eq_def Iterate.prems(2,3) xcalled by auto
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1) xcalled
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    have "points_inv_upd p' (p - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl'"
      using Iterate.prems(4) Stable(3,5) unfolding points_inv_upd_def points_inv_def by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using Stable(1,3,4,6,7) Iterate.prems Iterate.IH(1)
      unfolding update_rel_nar_def update_rel_def by simp
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    have A: "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(2-4) add_c_to_point_inv xcalled by (cases wn) auto
    have B: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
      using Iterate.prems(2,5) xcalled unfolding narrowing_inv_def
      by auto
    have subt: "subt_for_prefix (T x) [] σ = Some (T x)" "set [] ⊆ insert x stabl" by auto

    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1,4) xcalled inv A B called_dist subt, folded dep_def]

    have pinv': "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) σ' infl' stabl'"
      using IH
      unfolding post_invariant_def
    proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "eq_subsumed σ' (stabl' - (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}))"
        using Fixpoint(5) unfolding post_invariant_def by auto
      then show ?case using IH post_invariant_def by auto
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case using Fixpoint(5) by auto
    next
      case 3 then show ?case using Iterate.prems(2) by (simp add: insert_absorb)
    qed auto

    have ninv: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post'"
      using IH by auto

    show ?thesis using IH
    proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1 then show ?case using pinv' by simp
    next
      case 2 then show ?case using Fixpoint(3) unfolding update_rel_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
    next
      case 3 then show ?case using Fixpoint(6) unfolding points_inv_upd_def points_inv_def by auto
    next
      case 4
      show ?case
        unfolding narrowing_inv_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case
        proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
          case (1 u)
          then show ?case
          proof (cases "u = x")
            case True
            have "eq T x σ' ≤ mlup σ' x" using IH Fixpoint(5) by simp
            then show ?thesis using True by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same)
          next
            case False
            then show ?thesis using 1 4 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by simp
          qed
        qed
      next
        case 2
        then show ?case using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
      next
        case 3
        show ?case using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by simp
      next
        case 4
        have "∀y∈dep T σ' x. x ∈ slookup pinfl' y"
          using IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def narrowing_inv_def by fast
        then show ?case using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
      next
        case 5
        show ?case using IH narrowing_inv_def by fastforce
      qed
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case using 5 unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 3
        then show ?case by blast
      next
        case 4
        have "post - (c⇩w - {x}) ∩ {x} = insert x post - c⇩w ∩ {x}"
          using Iterate.prems(2) Fixpoint(1) xcalled by blast
        then show ?case using 4 by auto
      qed auto
    next
      case 6
      then show ?case unfolding update_rel_def by simp
    qed
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    have A: "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using Iterate.prems(2,3,4) W_Fixpoint(1) add_c_to_point_inv xcalled by (cases wn) auto
    have "slookup infl x = {}" using W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(3) unfolding post_invariant_def
      by (meson stabl_infl_empty)
    then have B: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
      using Iterate.prems(2,5) W_Fixpoint(3) xcalled unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    have subt: "subt_for_prefix (T x) [] σ = Some (T x)" "set [] ⊆ insert x stabl" by auto

    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5) xcalled inv A B called_dist subt, folded dep_def]
    (* post-solution reached for x *)
    have post1_x: "eq T x σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 x"
      using IH W_Fixpoint(6) widening_ge le_sup_iff eq_def by metis

    have infl2_def: "infl2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by infl1 x)) infl1"
      and stabl2_def: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[of infl2 stabl2 x infl1 stabl1] W_Fixpoint(8) by auto

    have "(slookup infl1 ξ - slookup infl ξ) ∩ stabl = {}" for ξ
      using Iterate.prems(3) W_Fixpoint(1) IH unfolding update_rel_def
      by auto
    then have stabl_inc: "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
      using Iterate.prems(3) W_Fixpoint(1,8) new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of infl1 infl stabl x]
        destab_infl_stabl_relation[of infl2 stabl2] IH
      unfolding post_invariant_def update_rel_def
      by auto

    have xd1_smaller: "xd1 ≤ mlup σ1 x" by (metis W_Fixpoint(6) le_sup_iff widening_ge)
    have sigma_narrow_smaller: "σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1) ⊑⇩m σ1"
    proof -
      have "mlup σ1 x Δ xd1 ≤ mlup σ1 x" using narrowing_le xd1_smaller by simp
      then show ?thesis 
        by (metis fun_upd_other fun_upd_same option.simps(5) order_class.order_eq_iff mlup_def)
    qed

    have "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) σ1 infl2 stabl2"
      using destab_preserves_invariant[OF W_Fixpoint(8) _ stabl_inc] IH dep_def
        Iterate.prems(3)[unfolded post_invariant_def] post1_x
      by auto
    then have pinv1': "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) infl2 stabl2"
      unfolding post_invariant_def
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case by simp
    next
      case 2
      have "eq T u (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) ≤ eq T u σ1" for u
        using sigma_narrow_smaller assms(1) unfolding is_mono_eq_def by auto
      moreover have "eq T u σ1 ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u"
        if "u ∈ stabl2 - (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x})" for u
      proof (cases "u = x")
        case True
        then have "mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u = mlup σ1 x Δ xd1"
          by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
        moreover have "mlup σ1 x Δ xd1 ≥ xd1"
          by (metis inf.absorb_iff2 narrowing_ge xd1_smaller)
        ultimately show ?thesis using IH True by simp
      next
        case False
        then have "mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u = mlup σ1 u"
          by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
        then show ?thesis using that 2 by simp
      qed
      ultimately show ?case using order_trans by blast
    next
      case 3
      then show ?case by simp
    next
      case 4
      have "dep T (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) y ⊆ dep T σ1 y" for y
        using sigma_narrow_smaller assms(2) unfolding mono_deps_def by auto
      moreover have "∀y∈stabl2 - (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}). ∀x∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup infl2 x"
        using Iterate.prems(2) 4 by force
      ultimately show ?case by blast
    qed

    have points_inv1: "points_inv (p1 - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl2"
      using IH continue_preserves_pinv W_Fixpoint(8) unfolding points_inv_upd_def by metis

    have "∀u. slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u" using infl2_def
      by (metis empty_iff fmlookup_default_drop_set set_empty2 subsetI)

    have "x ∈ p1" using W_Fixpoint(2) IH unfolding points_inv_upd_def by fast

    have nar_inv1: "narrowing_inv (Set.remove x c⇩w) (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1"
      using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case
      proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
        case (1 u)
        have "eq T u (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) ≤ eq T u σ1"
          using sigma_narrow_smaller assms(1) unfolding is_mono_eq_def by simp
        moreover have "eq T u σ1 ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u"
        proof (cases "u = x")
          case True
          have "mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u = mlup σ1 x Δ xd1"
            using True by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
          moreover have "mlup σ1 x Δ xd1 ≥ xd1"
            using narrowing_ge xd1_smaller by (metis inf.absorb_iff2)
          ultimately show ?thesis using IH A True by simp
        next
          case False
          then have "eq T u σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 u" using 1 by simp
          then show ?thesis using False A by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
        qed
        ultimately show ?case by auto
      qed
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case using W_Fixpoint(6) Iterate.prems(2) stabl2_def by auto
    next
      case 3
      then show ?case using W_Fixpoint(6) Iterate.prems(2) by auto
    next
      case 4
      have "dep T (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) y ⊆ dep T σ1 y" for y
        using sigma_narrow_smaller assms(2) unfolding mono_deps_def by auto
      moreover have "∀y∈post1 - Set.remove x c⇩w. ∀x∈dep T σ1 y. y ∈ slookup pinfl1 x"
        using Iterate.prems(2) 4 by force
      ultimately show ?case by blast
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case
        by (metis subset_trans ‹∀u. slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u›)
    qed

    have "x ∈ post1" using IH update_rel_nar_def by force

    have A: "(x ∈ Set.remove x c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post1 - stabl2) ∧ (x ∈ insert x c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post1)"
      using ‹x ∈ post1› by simp
    have B: "post_invariant (Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) infl2 stabl2"
      using pinv1' by (simp add: Un_Diff Set.remove_eq)
    have C: "points_inv (p1 - {x}) (Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x}) infl2"
      using points_inv1 by (simp add: Un_Diff Set.remove_eq)
    have D: "narrowing_inv (Set.remove x c⇩w - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1"
      using nar_inv1 by auto
    have E: "Set.remove x c⇩w ∩ insert x c⇩n = {}" using called_dist by auto
    have F: "x ∈ Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n" by blast
    have IH2: "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) σ' infl' stabl' ∧ stabl2 ⊆ stabl' ∧
