      update_rel x infl2 stabl2 infl' stabl' (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) σ' ∧
      points_inv_upd p' (p1 - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl' ∧
      narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post' ∧
      update_rel_nar x (c⇩w - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) σ' stabl2 post1 post' pinfl1 pinfl' ∧
      x ∈ stabl'"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
        W_Fixpoint(10) A B C D _ _ E F, of "(infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
        "(stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
        "(pinfl1, post1)", simplified] W_Fixpoint(2-3) ‹x ∈ p1› ‹x ∈ post1›
      unfolding update_rel_def by (simp add: Un_Diff Set.remove_eq)

    show ?thesis using IH IH2
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 2
      then show ?case unfolding update_rel_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case using IH2 stabl_inc by auto
      next
        case 2
        have "∀u∈stabl. slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl' u" using stabl_inc 2(2) by auto
        moreover have "∀u∈ stabl. slookup infl1 u ⊆ slookup infl2 u"
          using fmlookup_default_drop_set[of "insert x (influenced_by infl1 x)" infl1]
            W_Fixpoint(1) infl2_def stabl2_def stabl_inc by auto
        ultimately show ?case using 2(1) by fast
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case using 2 unfolding post_invariant_def
        proof(intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 ξ)
          have "slookup infl2 ξ ⊆ slookup infl1 ξ"
            using infl2_def unfolding fmlookup_default_def by auto
          moreover have "(slookup infl' ξ - slookup infl2 ξ) ∩ stabl = {}"
          proof (cases "x ∈ stabl2")
            case True
            then show ?thesis using W_Fixpoint(9,10) by auto
          next
            case False
            then show ?thesis
              using 1(2) inv[unfolded post_invariant_def] stabl_inc
              by fastforce
          qed
          moreover have "(slookup infl1 ξ - slookup infl ξ) ∩ stabl = {}"
            using W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(3) IH stabl_infl_empty[of x stabl infl]
            unfolding update_rel_def
            by auto
          ultimately show ?case using infl2_def stabl2_def by blast
        qed
      next
        case 4
        then have "∀ξ∈stabl. mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) ξ = mlup σ' ξ"
          "∀u∈stabl. mlup σ u = mlup σ1 u" using stabl_inc unfolding update_rel_def by auto
        moreover have "∀ξ∈stabl. mlup σ1 ξ = mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) ξ"
          using W_Fixpoint(1) by (metis fun_upd_other mlup_def)
        ultimately show ?case by auto
      qed
    next
      case 3
      then show ?case unfolding points_inv_upd_def points_inv_def by auto
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then have "post ⊆ post1" and "post1 ⊆ post'" by auto
        moreover have "post1 ⊆ post1" using W_Fixpoint(6) by auto
        ultimately show ?case by simp
      next
        case 2
        then have "∀u∈post. mlup σ1 u ≤ mlup σ u"
          "∀u∈post1. mlup σ' u ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u"
          by auto
        moreover have "post ⊆ post1" using 2(1) W_Fixpoint(6) by auto
        moreover have "post1 ⊆ post'" using 2(2) by simp
        ultimately show ?case using sigma_narrow_smaller by (meson order.trans subset_eq)
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case by (meson insertCI stabl_inc subset_eq)
      next
        case 4
        then show ?case
        proof(intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 ξ)
          have "(slookup pinfl' ξ - slookup pinfl1 ξ) ∩ post = {}"
          proof (cases "x ∈ stabl2")
            case True
            then show ?thesis using W_Fixpoint(9,10) by auto
          next
            case False
            have "∀u. (slookup pinfl' u - slookup pinfl1 u) ∩ (post1 - (c⇩w - {x}) ∩ {x}) = {}"
              using 1(2) by simp
            moreover have "post ⊆ post1 - (c⇩w - {x}) ∩ {x}" using 4(1) by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis by blast
          qed
          moreover have "(slookup pinfl1 ξ - slookup pinfl ξ) ∩ post = {}"
          proof -
            have "(slookup pinfl1 ξ - slookup pinfl ξ) ∩ (insert x post - c⇩w ∩ {x}) = {}"
              using W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(3) IH stabl_infl_empty[of x post pinfl] 4(1)
              by auto
            moreover have "post ⊆ insert x post - c⇩w ∩ {x}"
            proof (cases "x ∈ post")
              case True
              then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(2) W_Fixpoint(1) by blast
            next
              case False
              then have "x ∈ c⇩w" using Iterate.prems(2) xcalled by force
              then show ?thesis using False by simp
            qed
            ultimately show ?thesis by blast
          qed
          ultimately show ?case using infl2_def stabl2_def by blast
        qed
      qed
    qed auto
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    have T: "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using Iterate.prems(2-4) N_Fixpoint(1) add_c_to_point_inv xcalled by blast
    have "slookup infl x = {}" using N_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(3) unfolding post_invariant_def
      by (meson stabl_infl_empty)
    then have B: "narrowing_inv c⇩w  σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
    proof (cases "x ∈ c⇩w")
      case True
      then have "x ∉ post" using Iterate.prems(2) N_Fixpoint(1) by simp
      then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(5) True unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
    next
      case False
      then have "x ∈ c⇩n" using xcalled called_dist by simp
      then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(2,5) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    qed

    have subt: "subt_for_prefix (T x) [] σ = Some (T x)" "set [] ⊆ insert x stabl" by auto

    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1,5) xcalled inv T B called_dist subt, folded dep_def]

    have post_x: "eq T x σ' ≤ mlup σ' x"
    proof (cases "x ∈ c⇩w")
      case True
      then have "wn = Widening" using Iterate.prems(6) called_dist by (cases wn) auto
      then have "mlup σ' x ∇ xd1 = mlup σ' x" using N_Fixpoint(3) by simp
      then have "xd1 ≤ mlup σ' x" by (metis le_sup_iff widening_ge)
      then show ?thesis using IH by auto
    next
      case False
      then have "x ∈ post' - c⇩w" using IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def by blast
      then show ?thesis using IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def narrowing_inv_def by metis
    qed

    have "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) σ' infl' stabl'"
      using IH N_Fixpoint(2,3) post_x unfolding post_invariant_def by auto

    moreover have "points_inv_upd p' (p - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl'"
      using IH N_Fixpoint(8) unfolding points_inv_upd_def points_inv_def by auto

    moreover have "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post'"
      using IH
      unfolding narrowing_inv_def
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case
      proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
        case (1 u)
        then show ?case
        proof (cases "u = x")
          case True
          have "eq T x σ' ≤ mlup σ' x" using post_x by simp
          then show ?thesis using N_Fixpoint(8) True by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same)
        next
          case False
          then have "u ∈ post'" using N_Fixpoint(8) 1 by simp
          then show ?thesis using 1 False by blast
        qed
      qed
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case using Iterate.prems(2) xstabl N_Fixpoint(8) by auto
    next
      case 3
      then show ?case using N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(2) by blast
    next
      case 4
      then show ?case using N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(2) by blast
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case by meson
    qed

    moreover have "post ⊆ post'" using IH N_Fixpoint(8) unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto

    moreover have "(slookup pinfl' u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ (post - (c⇩w - {x}) ∩ {x}) = {}" for u
    proof (cases "x ∈ c⇩w")
      case True
      then have "x ∉ post" using Iterate.prems(2) N_Fixpoint(1) by simp
      then show ?thesis using IH True update_rel_nar_def by auto
    next
      case False
      then show ?thesis using IH update_rel_nar_def by auto
    qed

    ultimately show ?thesis
      using IH N_Fixpoint(8) unfolding post_invariant_def update_rel_nar_def update_rel_def by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have infl2_def: "infl2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by infl1 x)) infl1"
      and stabl2_def: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by infl1 x"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[of infl2 stabl2 x infl1 stabl1] Continue(6) by auto

    have A: "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using Iterate.prems(2-4) Continue(1) add_c_to_point_inv xcalled by blast
    have "slookup infl x = {}" using Continue(1) Iterate.prems(3) unfolding post_invariant_def
      by (meson stabl_infl_empty)
    moreover have "insert x post - c⇩w = post - (c⇩w - {x})"
      using Iterate.prems(2) Continue(1) xcalled by blast
    ultimately have B: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
      using Iterate.prems(2,5,6) xcalled unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    have subt: "subt_for_prefix (T x) [] σ = Some (T x)" "set [] ⊆ insert x stabl" by auto

    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1,3) xcalled inv A B called_dist subt]

    have "p ⊆ p1" using IH Continue(2) unfolding points_inv_def points_inv_upd_def by auto

    have "(slookup infl1 ξ - slookup infl ξ) ∩ stabl = {}" for ξ
      using Iterate.prems(3) Continue(1) IH unfolding update_rel_def
      by auto
    then have stabl_inc: "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
      using Iterate.prems(3) Continue(1) new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of infl1 infl stabl x]
        stabl2_def IH
      unfolding post_invariant_def update_rel_def
      by auto

    have infl_closed: "(∀x∈stabl1 - ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}). ∀y∈dep T σ1 x. x ∈ slookup infl1 y)"
      using IH[unfolded post_invariant_def, folded dep_def] by auto

    have x_no_dep: "x ∉ dep T σ1 y" if "y ∈ stabl2 - ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x})" for y
      using that destab_x_no_dep[OF Continue(6) infl_closed] by fastforce

    have in_post_N: "x ∈ post" if "wn = Narrowing"
      using Iterate.prems(2,6) that by fastforce

    have "post ⊆ post1" using IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp
    have I1: "∀z ∈ dep T σ1 x. x ∈ slookup infl1 z" using IH unfolding dep_def by auto

    have post_dom_incr: "post ⊆ post2"
      using post_dom_incr IH Iterate.prems(2,3,5) Continue(1,7) called_dist xcalled
      unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      by (smt (verit, best))

    have post1_x: "eq T x σ1 ≤ mlup σ1 x" if "x ∈ post"
    proof -
      have "x ∈ c⇩n" and "x ∉ c⇩w"
        using Iterate.prems(2) Continue(1) that xcalled by auto
      then show ?thesis using IH that unfolding update_rel_nar_def narrowing_inv_def by auto
    qed

    have "p ⊆ p1" using IH unfolding points_inv_def points_inv_upd_def by simp

    have inv: "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) infl2 stabl2"
      using post_inv_after_destab[OF Continue(4,6) Iterate.prems(3,7) stabl_inc] post1_x in_post_N
        IH x_no_dep using x_no_dep unfolding update_rel_def by auto

    have ninv1: "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) infl2 stabl2 pinfl2 post2"
      using narrow_inv_after_destab[OF assms(1,2) Continue(4,5,6,7) Iterate.prems(2,3,5-7) _
          stabl_inc _ xcalled called_dist inv] in_post_N post1_x x_no_dep IH by auto

    have d_new:
        "d_new = (if x ∉ p then xd1 else if wn = Widening then mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1 else mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)"
      using Continue(4) by simp

    have pointsinv1: "points_inv (p1 - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl2"
      using continue_preserves_pinv[OF Continue(6)[symmetric]] IH infl2_def
      unfolding points_inv_upd_def by simp
    have P2: "x ∉ p1 ⟶ wn = Widening" using ‹p ⊆ p1› Iterate.prems(7) by blast
    have "x ∈ stabl1" "x ∈ post1" using IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def update_rel_def by auto
    then have P3: "(x ∈ c⇩w ⟶ x ∉ post2 - stabl2) ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post2)"
      using c_post_after_destab[OF Iterate.prems(2) called_dist xcalled Continue(1,6,7)
          post_dom_incr Iterate.prems(5)] IH
      unfolding dep_def by auto

    have dnew_smaller_if_x_post: "d_new ≤ mlup σ1 x" if "x ∈ post - c⇩w"
      using IH Continue(4) narrowing_le post1_x widening_bounded that by force

    note ih = Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ d_new Continue(5,6) _
        Continue(7) _ Continue(9) P3 inv pointsinv1 ninv1 Iterate.prems(6) P2 called_dist
        xcalled, of "(infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
        "(p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(pinfl1, post1)", simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH
    proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case by simp
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case unfolding update_rel_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case using ih stabl_inc by auto
      next
        case 2
        then have "∀u∈stabl. slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl' u" using stabl_inc by auto
        moreover have "∀u ∈ stabl. slookup infl1 u ⊆ slookup infl2 u"
          using fmlookup_default_drop_set[of "insert x (influenced_by infl1 x)" infl1] infl2_def
            stabl2_def Continue(1) stabl_inc by auto
        ultimately show ?case using 2(2) by fast
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case unfolding post_invariant_def
        proof(intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 ξ)
          have "slookup infl2 ξ ⊆ slookup infl1 ξ"
            using infl2_def unfolding fmlookup_default_def by auto
          moreover have "(slookup infl' ξ - slookup infl2 ξ) ∩ stabl = {}"
          proof (cases "x ∈ stabl2")
            case True
            then show ?thesis using Continue(8,9) by auto
          next
            case False
            then show ?thesis
              using 1(1) inv[unfolded post_invariant_def] stabl_inc
              by fastforce
          qed
          moreover have "(slookup infl1 ξ - slookup infl ξ) ∩ stabl = {}"
            using Continue(1) Iterate.prems(3) 3(2) stabl_infl_empty[of x stabl infl]
            by auto
          ultimately show ?case using infl2_def stabl2_def by blast
        qed
      next
        case 4
        then have "∀ξ∈stabl. mlup (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) ξ = mlup σ' ξ" using stabl_inc by auto
        moreover have "∀ξ∈insert x stabl. mlup σ ξ = mlup σ1 ξ" using 4(2) by simp
        moreover have "∀ξ∈stabl. mlup σ1 ξ = mlup (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) ξ"
          using Continue(1) by (simp add: mlup_eq_mupd_set)
        ultimately show ?case by auto
      qed
    next
      case 4 then show ?case using IH by auto
    next
      case 3
      then show ?case unfolding points_inv_upd_def by blast
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then have "post2 ⊆ post'" by simp
        then show ?case using post_dom_incr by simp
      next
        case 2
        have "∀u∈post. mlup σ1 u ≤ mlup σ u" using IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp
        moreover have "∀u∈post. mlup σ' u ≤ mlup (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) u"
          using ih post_dom_incr unfolding update_rel_nar_def by blast
        moreover have "∀u∈post. mlup (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) u ≤ mlup σ1 u"
        proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
          case (1 u)
          then show ?case
          proof (cases "u = x")
            case True
            have "x ∉ c⇩w" using 1 Iterate.prems(2,7) True Continue(1,2) by blast
            then show ?thesis
              using dnew_smaller_if_x_post True 1 by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
          next
            case False
            then show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
          qed
        qed
        ultimately show ?case by force
      next
        case 3
        show ?case
        proof(intro allI subsetI, goal_cases)
          case (1 ξ u)
          then have "ξ ∈ post"
            using Iterate.prems(5) unfolding narrowing_inv_def
            by (metis stabl_infl_empty empty_iff)
          then show ?case
          proof (cases "x ∈ post")
            case True
            then have "pinfl2 = pinfl1" "post2 = post1"
              using Continue(7) unfolding destab_post_def by auto
            moreover have "slookup pinfl ξ ⊆ slookup pinfl1 ξ" "ξ ∈ post1"
              using ‹ξ ∈ post› IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
            moreover have "slookup pinfl2 ξ ⊆ slookup pinfl' ξ"
              using ‹ξ ∈ post1› ‹post2 = post1› 3 unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis using 1(1) by auto
          next
            case False
            have "u ∈ slookup pinfl1 ξ" using IH 1 unfolding update_rel_nar_def by blast
            have destab_post: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_barrier x pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
              using Continue(7) False unfolding destab_post_def by simp

            have "ξ ≠ x" using ‹ξ ∈ post› False by auto
            have "ξ ∈ post2" using ‹ξ ∈ post› post_dom_incr by blast
            then have "ξ ∉ insert x (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})) - stabl2"
              using destab_post ‹ξ ∈ post› ‹ξ ≠ x›
              unfolding destab_barrier_def by auto
            then have "slookup pinfl1 ξ = slookup pinfl2 ξ"
              using destab_post fmlookup_default_drop_set unfolding destab_barrier_def
              by (auto simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set)
            then have "u ∈ slookup pinfl2 ξ" using ‹u ∈ slookup pinfl1 ξ› by auto
            then show ?thesis using post_dom_incr 1(1) 3 by auto
          qed
        qed
      next
        case 4
        have "∀u. slookup pinfl2 u ⊆ slookup pinfl1 u"
        proof (cases ‹x ∈ post›)
          case True
          then show ?thesis using Continue(7) unfolding destab_post_def by simp
        next
          case False
          have "pinfl2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by_cutoff pinfl1 x (stabl2 - {x})) - stabl2) pinfl1"
            using Continue(7) False unfolding destab_post_def destab_barrier_def by simp
          then show ?thesis by (simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set subset_eq)
        qed
        moreover have "∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ post = {}"
        proof -
          have "∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ (insert x post - c⇩w ∩ {x}) = {}"
            using 4 IH Continue(1) unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
          then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(2) Continue(1) by blast
        qed
        moreover have "∀u. (slookup pinfl' u - slookup pinfl2 u) ∩ post2 = {}"
          using 4 IH Continue(1) unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
        moreover have "post ⊆ post2" using Continue(1) post_dom_incr by auto
        ultimately show ?case by blast
      qed
    qed auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1)
    have "y ∈ dep_aux σ t" using Query(1) by auto
    have "x ∈ stabl" using Eval.prems(2,3) unfolding post_invariant_def by auto
    then have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre σ = Some t" "set pre ⊆ stabl"
      using Eval.prems(7,8) by auto
    then have "t ∈ subt T σ x"
      using subt_for_prefix_implies_subt unfolding subt_def by fast
    then have y_dep_of_x: "y ∈ dep T σ x"
      by (simp add: Query(1) dep_def subt_def subt_implies_dep)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3) Eval.prems(3-6,2) y_dep_of_x]
    then have inv: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1" by simp
    have D: "points_inv p1 (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl1" using IH unfolding points_inv_upd_def by simp
    have E: "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1" using IH by simp

    have "mlup σ1 y = yd" by (meson Query(2) Query(3) query_fmlookup)

    have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre σ1 = Some t"
      using IH Eval.prems(7,8) subt_for_prefix_same unfolding update_rel_def by (metis subsetD)
    moreover have "subt_for_prefix t [y] σ1 = Some (g yd)" using Query(1) ‹mlup σ1 y = yd› by simp
    ultimately have F1: "subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [y]) σ1 = Some (g yd)"
      using subt_for_prefix_transitive by blast
    have "y ∈ stabl1"
      using IH stabl_infl_empty unfolding post_invariant_def by (metis empty_iff)
    then have F2: "set (pre @ [y]) ⊆ stabl1"
      using ‹set pre ⊆ stabl› IH  unfolding update_rel_def by auto

    have "t ∈ subt T σ1 x"
      using subt_for_prefix_implies_subt ‹subt_for_prefix (T x) pre σ1 = Some t›
      unfolding subt_def by fast
    then have F: "g yd ∈ subt T σ1 x"
      using Query(1) subt_aux.step[of t σ1 "T x" y g] ‹mlup σ1 y = yd›
      unfolding subt_def by auto

    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Query(5) Eval.prems(2) inv D E Eval.prems(6) F1 F2,
        of "(infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)"
        "(p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(σ1, pinfl1, post1)" "(pinfl1, post1)", simplified]

    have "y ∈ stabl1"
      using IH stabl_infl_empty[of y stabl1 infl1]
      unfolding post_invariant_def
      by fastforce
    then have "mlup σ1 y = mlup σ' y"
      using ih unfolding update_rel_def by fastforce
    then have mlup: "mlup σ' y = yd"
      using Query(2,3) query_fmlookup by metis

    show ?thesis using ih IH
    proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 2
      then show ?case unfolding update_rel_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case by (metis subset_trans)
      next
        case 2
        then show ?case by (meson subset_trans in_mono)
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case using infl_diff_eval_step by (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting))
      next
        case 4
        then show ?case by (metis in_mono)
      qed
    next
      case 3
      then show ?case unfolding points_inv_def points_inv_upd_def by auto 
    next
      case 4
      show ?case using ih by simp
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case by (simp add: subset_iff)
      next
        case 2
        then show ?case by (meson order_trans subsetD)
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case by (meson dual_order.trans subsetD)
      next
        case 4
        then show ?case
        proof (cases "x ∈ c⇩w")
          case True
          then have A: "∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ (post - {x}) = {}" and
            B: "∀u. (slookup pinfl' u - slookup pinfl1 u) ∩ (post1 - {x}) = {}" using 4 by auto
          show ?thesis using infl_diff_eval_step[OF _ B A] 4(2) True by simp
        next
          case False
          then have A: "∀u. (slookup pinfl1 u - slookup pinfl u) ∩ post = {}" and
            B: "∀u. (slookup pinfl' u - slookup pinfl1 u) ∩ post1 = {}" using 4 by auto
          then show ?thesis using infl_diff_eval_step_2[OF _ B A] 4(2) False by simp
        qed
      qed
    next
      case 6
      then show ?case by (simp add: Query(1) mlup)
    next
      case 7
      then show ?case using Query(1) ‹y ∈ stabl1› mlup unfolding update_rel_def by fastforce
    qed auto
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis
      using Eval.prems(2-5)
      unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def update_rel_def points_inv_upd_def
      by (auto split: prod.splits)
  qed
qed

corollary partial_correctness:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
      and "mono_deps T"
      and "solve_dom x"
      and "solve x = (stabl, σ)"
    shows "part_post_solution T x σ stabl"
proof -
  note dom = assms(3)[unfolded solve_dom_def]
  obtain xd infl p pinfl post where app: "(xd, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post)
      = iterate x {x} {} fmempty {} {} Map.empty Widening fmempty {}"
    using assms unfolding solve_def
    by (cases "iterate x {x} {} fmempty {} {} Map.empty Widening fmempty {}") auto
  show ?thesis
    using partial_correctness_ind(2)[OF assms(1,2) dom app] dep_subset_stable[of infl stabl "{}"]
    unfolding solve_dom_def post_invariant_def points_inv_def narrowing_inv_def
    by auto
qed

end ― ‹end of @{term TD_wn_post} locale›


subsection ‹Equivalence of Starting with Widening or Narrowing Phase for Post Unknowns›

context TD_wn_post
begin

lemma widening_for_narrowing_iterate:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "mono_deps T"
    and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post"
    and "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) σ infl stabl"
    and "points_inv (p - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl"
    and "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
    and "x ∈ p"
    and "c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}"
    and "x ∈ c⇩n"
    and "x ∈ post"
    shows "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post
      ∧ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
proof -
  have xcalled: "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using assms(10) by simp
  show ?thesis using assms(3,4) xcalled
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
      using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Widening] by auto
    then show ?thesis using iterate.psimps Stable by simp
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    then have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
      using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Widening]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") fastforce
    then show ?thesis
      using iterate.psimps[of x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post] Fixpoint
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    then show ?thesis by blast
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    have narrow_fix: "mlup σ' x Δ xd1 = mlup σ' x" using N_Fixpoint(6,7) by simp

    have "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ infl (insert x stabl)"
      using assms(5) xcalled post_invariant_simp_c_stabl by auto
    moreover have "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using assms(5,6) N_Fixpoint(1) ‹x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› add_c_to_point_inv by auto
    moreover have "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
      using xcalled assms(7,9,10,11) narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post by blast
    ultimately have parCorr: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ' infl' stabl' ∧
      update_rel x infl (insert x stabl) infl' stabl' σ σ' ∧
      points_inv_upd p1 p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl' ∧
      narrowing_inv c⇩w σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post' ∧
      update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ' (insert x stabl) (insert x post) post' pinfl pinfl' ∧
      traverse_rhs (T x) σ' = xd1 ∧ (∀y∈dep_aux σ' (T x). x ∈ slookup infl' y)"
      using partial_correctness_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) N_Fixpoint(4,5) xcalled, of "[]"] assms(9)
      by auto
    have "xd1 ≤ mlup σ' x"
    proof -
      have "x ∉ c⇩w" using assms(9,10) by auto
      then have "x ∈ post' - c⇩w" using parCorr unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using parCorr unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    qed
    then have widen_fix: "mlup σ' x = mlup σ' x ∇ xd1" using widening_bounded by auto

    have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
      using N_Fixpoint(1,2,4,5) widen_fix narrow_fix query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w
          c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Widening] by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl
          (insert x post)", cases "destab x infl' stabl'") auto
    then show ?thesis
      using N_Fixpoint(1,2,4,5,7,8) widen_fix narrow_fix iterate.psimps[of x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening
          pinfl post] by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have narrow_not_fix: "mlup σ1 x Δ xd1 ≠ mlup σ1 x" using assms(8) Continue(4,5) by auto
    have d_new: "d_new = mlup σ1 x Δ xd1" using assms(8) Continue(4,5) by auto
    have "x ∈ post" using assms(5,11) by blast
    then have no_destab_post: "pinfl2 = pinfl1" "post2 = post1"
      using Continue(7) unfolding destab_post_def by auto
    have called_upd: "Set.remove x c⇩w = c⇩w" "insert x c⇩n = c⇩n" using assms(9,10) by auto

    have "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ infl (insert x stabl)"
      using assms(5) ‹x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› post_invariant_simp_c_stabl by auto
    moreover have "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using assms(5,6,10) Continue(1) add_c_to_point_inv by auto
    moreover have "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
      using assms(7,9-11) narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post by blast
    ultimately have parCorr: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1 ∧
      update_rel x infl (insert x stabl) infl1 stabl1 σ σ1 ∧
      points_inv_upd p1 p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl1 ∧
      narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1 ∧
      update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 (insert x stabl) (insert x post) post1 pinfl pinfl1 ∧
      traverse_rhs (T x) σ1 = xd1 ∧ (∀y∈dep_aux σ1 (T x). x ∈ slookup infl1 y)"
      using partial_correctness_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) Continue(2,3) _, of "[]"] assms(9-10)
      by auto
    then have "xd1 ≤ mlup σ1 x"
    proof -
      have "x ∉ c⇩w" using assms(9-10) by auto
      then have "x ∈ post1 - c⇩w" using parCorr unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using parCorr unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    qed
    then have widen_fix: "mlup σ1 x = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1" using widening_bounded by auto
    have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
      using Continue(1-3,6,8) assms(8) called_upd no_destab_post d_new widen_fix
        narrow_not_fix query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Widening]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
          cases "destab x infl1 stabl1") auto
    then show ?thesis
      using Continue(1,3,6,9) assms(8) iterate.psimps[of x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post]
        widen_fix narrow_not_fix d_new no_destab_post called_upd
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
          cases "destab x infl1 stabl1") auto
  qed
qed

lemma narrowing_for_widening_iterate:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "mono_deps T"
    and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
    and "(xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
    and "post_invariant ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) σ infl stabl"
    and "points_inv (p - {x}) ((c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) - {x}) infl"
    and "narrowing_inv (c⇩w - {x}) σ infl stabl pinfl post"
    and "x ∈ p"
    and "c⇩w ∩ c⇩n = {}"
    and "x ∈ c⇩n"
    and "x ∈ post"
    shows "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post
    ∧ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post"
proof -
  have "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using assms(10) by simp
  show ?thesis using assms(3,4) ‹x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n›
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post"
      using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Narrowing] by auto
    then show ?thesis using iterate.psimps Stable by simp
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    then have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post"
      using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Narrowing]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") fastforce
    then show ?thesis
      using iterate.psimps[of x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post] Fixpoint
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    obtain pinfl2 post2 where destab_post: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
      by (cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2") auto
    have c_simp: "Set.remove x c⇩w = c⇩w" "insert x c⇩n = c⇩n" using assms(9,10) by auto
    then have i2_N_dom: "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) Narrowing pinfl2 post2"
      using W_Fixpoint(9) assms(11) destab_post unfolding destab_post_def
      by (auto split: if_splits)
    then have i_dom_N: "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post"
      using W_Fixpoint(1,4,5,6,2,8) destab_post query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of
          x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Narrowing]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
          cases "destab x infl1 stabl1", cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2")
         (auto simp del: eval.psimps)
    have i_val_N: "iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post =
        iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1"
      using W_Fixpoint(1,5,2,7,8) destab_post assms(11) iterate.psimps[OF i_dom_N[unfolded dom_defs]]
      unfolding destab_post_def
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
          cases "destab x infl1 stabl1") auto

    have i_dom_W: "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
      using W_Fixpoint(1,4,5,6,7,2,8,9) query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Widening]
      unfolding destab_post_def
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
          cases "destab x infl1 stabl1") auto
    have "iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post =
        iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1"
      using iterate.psimps[OF i_dom_W[unfolded dom_defs]] W_Fixpoint(1,2,5,6,7,8) c_simp
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
          cases "destab x infl1 stabl1") auto
    then show ?thesis using i_dom_N i_val_N assms(4) by auto
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    have narrow_fix: "mlup σ' x Δ xd1 = mlup σ' x" using N_Fixpoint(6,7) by simp

    have "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ infl (insert x stabl)"
      using assms(5,10) post_invariant_simp_c_stabl by auto
    moreover have "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using assms(5,6) N_Fixpoint(1) ‹x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› add_c_to_point_inv by auto
    moreover have "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
      using assms(7,9-11) narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post by blast
    ultimately have parCorr: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ' infl' stabl' ∧
      update_rel x infl (insert x stabl) infl' stabl' σ σ' ∧
      points_inv_upd p1 p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl' ∧
      narrowing_inv c⇩w σ' infl' stabl' pinfl' post' ∧
      update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ' (insert x stabl) (insert x post) post' pinfl pinfl' ∧
      traverse_rhs (T x) σ' = xd1 ∧ (∀y∈dep_aux σ' (T x). x ∈ slookup infl' y)"
      using partial_correctness_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) N_Fixpoint(4,5) _, of "[]"] assms(9,10)
      by auto
    then have "xd1 ≤ mlup σ' x"
    proof -
      have "x ∉ c⇩w" using assms(9,10) by auto
      then have "x ∈ post' - c⇩w" using parCorr unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using parCorr unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    qed
    then have widen_fix: "mlup σ' x = mlup σ' x ∇ xd1" using widening_bounded by auto

    have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post"
      using N_Fixpoint(1,2,4,5) widen_fix narrow_fix query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post Narrowing]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)", cases "destab x infl' stabl'")
         auto
    then show ?thesis
      using N_Fixpoint(1,2,4,5,7,8) widen_fix narrow_fix iterate.psimps[of x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ Narrowing pinfl post]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have widen_not_fix: "mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1 ≠ mlup σ1 x" using assms(8) Continue(4,5) by auto

    have "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ infl (insert x stabl)"
      using assms(5) ‹x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› post_invariant_simp_c_stabl by auto
    moreover have "points_inv p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl"
      using assms(5,6,10) Continue(1) add_c_to_point_inv by auto
    moreover have "narrowing_inv c⇩w σ infl (insert x stabl) pinfl (insert x post)"
      using assms(7,9-11) narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post by blast
    ultimately have parCorr: "post_invariant (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) σ1 infl1 stabl1 ∧
      update_rel x infl (insert x stabl) infl1 stabl1 σ σ1 ∧
      points_inv_upd p1 p (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl1 ∧
      narrowing_inv c⇩w σ1 infl1 stabl1 pinfl1 post1 ∧
      update_rel_nar x c⇩w σ σ1 (insert x stabl) (insert x post) post1 pinfl pinfl1 ∧
      traverse_rhs (T x) σ1 = xd1 ∧ (∀y∈dep_aux σ1 (T x). x ∈ slookup infl1 y)"
      using partial_correctness_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) Continue(2,3) _, of "[]"] assms(9,10)
      by auto
    then have "xd1 ≤ mlup σ1 x"
    proof -
      have "x ∉ c⇩w" using assms(9,10) by auto
      then have "x ∈ post1 - c⇩w" using parCorr unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using parCorr unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    qed
    then have widen_fix: "mlup σ1 x = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd1" using widening_bounded by auto
    then show ?thesis using widen_not_fix by auto
  qed
qed

end ― ‹end of context for partial correctness proof›


subsection ‹Termination›

context TD_wn_post
begin

context
  assumes widening_finite: "wf {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a}"
    and narrowing_finite: "wf {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a}"
    (* just wf {(x,y). ∃a. x = y ∇ a} as assumption causes contradiction due to wf_not_refl and
       widening_bounded *)
    and finite_vars: "finite (UNIV :: 'x set)"
begin

subsection‹Construction of Wellfounded Relation for Termination Proof›

type_synonym ('a,'b) query_in =
  "'a × 'a × 'a set × 'a set × ('a, 'a list) fmap × 'a set × 'a set × ('a, 'b) map ×
  ('a, 'a list) fmap × 'a set"
type_synonym ('a,'b) iterate_in =
  "'a × 'a set × 'a set × ('a, 'a list) fmap × 'a set × 'a set × ('a, 'b) map × phase ×
  ('a, 'a list) fmap × 'a set"
type_synonym ('a,'b) eval_in =
  "'a × ('a, 'b) strategy_tree × 'a set × 'a set × ('a, 'a list) fmap × 'a set × 'a set ×
  ('a, 'b) map × ('a, 'a list) fmap × 'a set"


text ‹For finding a fitting termination relation for the solver with widening, we make the following
  considerations:
  - Most of the termination relation for TD\_plain can be reused. The differing and therefore
    interesting case is when continuing with the iteration.
  - For termination we do not require monotonicity of right-hand sides, since the widening operator
    guarantees accumulation at widening points. Additionally, we require the textbook property for
    widening operators that chains composed of repeated application of the widening operator need
    to be finite.
  - Because the check, whether x is in point is done based on the previous point set, there is one
    special iteration in the beginning where the value of x is not yet widened. We cover this
    iteration by adding an extra component to the lexicographic order that covers the case when
    x was not in point before and is now added to it.
›

definition points_relation :: "(('x × 'x set) × ('x × 'x set)) set" where
  "points_relation = {((x',p'),(x,p)). x' ∈ p' ∧ x ∉ p}"

lemma wf_points_relation: "wf points_relation"
proof (intro wfI_min, goal_cases)
  case (1 t Q)
  obtain x p where "t = (x, p)" by fastforce
  then show ?case
  proof (cases "x ∈ p")
    case True
    then have "(y, (x, p)) ∉ points_relation" for y
      unfolding points_relation_def by auto
    then show ?thesis using 1 ‹t = (x, p)› by blast
  next
    case False
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "∃(x',p') ∈ Q. x' ∈ p'")
      case True
      then obtain x' p' where "(x',p') ∈ Q" and "x' ∈ p'" by auto
      then have "∀y ∈ Q. (y, (x', p')) ∉ points_relation"
        unfolding points_relation_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using 1 ‹t = (x, p)› ‹(x', p') ∈ Q› by blast
    next
      case False
      then have "∀(x',p') ∈ Q. x' ∉ p'" by auto
      then have "∀y ∈ Q. (y, (x, p)) ∉ points_relation"
        unfolding points_relation_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using 1 ‹t = (x, p)› by blast
    qed
  qed
qed

definition value_relation :: "((phase × 'd) × (phase × 'd)) set" where
  "value_relation = {((p2,d2),(p1,d1)). p1 = Widening ∧ p2 = Narrowing}
    ∪ {((p1,d1),(p2,d2)). p1 = Widening ∧ p2 = Widening ∧ (d1,d2) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a}}
    ∪ {((p1,d1),(p2,d2)). p1 = Narrowing ∧ p2 = Narrowing ∧ (d1,d2) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a}}"

lemma wf_value_relation: "wf value_relation"
proof (intro wfI_min, goal_cases)
  case (1 t Q)
  define Q⇩N where qn_def: "Q⇩N = {(p,d) ∈ Q. p = Narrowing}"
  define Q⇩W where qw_def: "Q⇩W = {(p,d) ∈ Q. p = Widening}"
  have "Q = Q⇩N ∪ Q⇩W" unfolding qn_def qw_def using phase.exhaust by blast
  define Qd⇩N where qdn_def: "Qd⇩N = {d. (Narrowing,d) ∈ Q}"
  define Qd⇩W where qdw_def: "Qd⇩W = {d. (Widening,d) ∈ Q}"
  
  show ?case
  proof (cases "Qd⇩N = {}")
    case True
    then obtain dt where "t = (Widening,dt)"
      using 1 qdn_def qdw_def phase.exhaust
      by (metis (mono_tags, lifting) ex_in_conv mem_Collect_eq old.prod.exhaust)
    then have "dt ∈ Qd⇩W" using qdw_def 1 by auto
    then obtain d⇩m⇩i⇩n where d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def:
      "d⇩m⇩i⇩n ∈ Qd⇩W" "∀d'. (d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a} ⟶ d' ∉ Qd⇩W"
      using widening_finite wfE_min by meson
    then have "(Widening,d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ Q" using qdw_def by simp 
    moreover have "((p',d'),(Widening,d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation ⟶ (p',d') ∉ Q" for p' d'
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "((p', d'), (Widening, d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation" "(p', d') ∈ Q" by auto
      have "p' = Widening" using ‹(p', d') ∈ Q› True unfolding qdn_def by (cases p') auto
      then have "(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a}"
        using ‹((p', d'), (Widening, d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation› unfolding value_relation_def by auto
      have "d' ∈ Qd⇩W" using qdw_def ‹(p', d') ∈ Q› ‹p' = Widening› by simp
      moreover have "d' ∉ Qd⇩W" using d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def ‹(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a}› by auto
      ultimately show ?case by simp
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case False
    then obtain d⇩m⇩i⇩n where d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def: "d⇩m⇩i⇩n ∈ Qd⇩N" 
      "∀d'. (d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a} ⟶ d' ∉ Qd⇩N"
      using narrowing_finite by (meson wfE_min')
    then have "(Narrowing,d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ Q" using qdn_def by simp 
    moreover have "((p',d'),(Narrowing,d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation ⟶ (p',d') ∉ Q" for p' d'
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "((p', d'), (Narrowing, d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation" "(p', d') ∈ Q" by auto
      then have "p' = Narrowing" "(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a}"
        unfolding value_relation_def by auto
      have "d' ∈ Qd⇩N" using qdn_def ‹(p', d') ∈ Q› ‹p' = Narrowing› by simp
      moreover have "d' ∉ Qd⇩N" using d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def ‹(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a}› by auto
      ultimately show ?case by simp
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

definition prod_relation :: "(('x set × nat × ('x, 'd) strategy_tree × nat × (phase × 'd))
    × ('x set × nat × ('x, 'd) strategy_tree × nat × (phase × 'd))) set" where
  "prod_relation = lex_prod c_relation (lex_prod (measure id) (lex_prod
    strict_subt_relation (lex_prod (measure id) value_relation)))"

lemma wf_prod_relation: "wf prod_relation"
  unfolding prod_relation_def c_relation_def
  using widening_finite c_relation_def wf_rhs_relation wf_points_relation wf_value_relation
  by blast

definition term_relation :: "((('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in) ×
   (('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in)) set"
  where
  "term_relation = inv_image prod_relation (λst. case st of
      Inl (x,y,c⇩w,c⇩n,infl,stabl,p,σ,pinfl,post) ⇒ (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n, 1, T x, 0, (Widening, mlup σ x))
    | Inr (Inl (x,c⇩w,c⇩n,infl,stabl,p,σ,wn,pinfl,post)) ⇒
        (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n, 3, T x, if x ∉ p then 1 else 0, (wn, mlup σ x))
    | Inr (Inr (x,t,c⇩w,c⇩n,infl,stabl,p,σ,pinfl,post)) ⇒ (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n, 2, t, 0, (Widening, mlup σ x)))"

lemma wf_term_relation: "wf term_relation"
  unfolding term_relation_def
  by (simp add: wf_prod_relation)


subsection‹Auxiliary Lemmas›

lemma constant_vals_for_called:
  shows "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (∀u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. mlup σ' u = mlup σ u)"
    and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ⟹ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ (∀u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. mlup σ' u = mlup σ u)"
    and "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (∀u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. mlup σ' u = mlup σ u)"
proof(induction y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post and x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    and y t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    arbitrary: xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post' and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate infl1 pinfl1 c1⇩w c1⇩n)
    show ?thesis
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,4) _ Iterate(3)] Iterate(1,4) by (auto split: if_splits)
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1,4)] by simp
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "∀u∈c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. mlup σ1 u = mlup σ u" using Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5)] by simp
    have IH2: "∀u∈Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x}. mlup σ' u = mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
            W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) by fastforce
    have "∀u∈c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd1)) u = mlup σ1 u"
      by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(2) IH1 IH2 by auto
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1,5)] by simp
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have IH1: "∀u∈c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. mlup σ1 u = mlup σ u" using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1,3)] by simp
    have IH2: "∀u∈c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. mlup σ' u = mlup (σ1(x ↦ d_new)) u"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(7) _
            Continue(9) Iterate.prems(2)] by auto
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(2) IH1 by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "∀u∈c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. mlup σ1 u = mlup σ u" using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] by simp
    have IH2: "∀u∈c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. mlup σ' u = mlup σ1 u" 
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Query(5)] by simp
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by simp
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

lemma point_set_subset_c:
  shows "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
    and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ⟹ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}"
    and "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
proof(induction y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post and x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    and y t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    arbitrary: xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post' and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate infl1 pinfl1 c1⇩w c1⇩n)
    have IH: "p' ⊆ c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x}"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,4) _ Iterate(3)] Iterate(4) Query.prems(2)
      by (auto split: if_splits)
    moreover have "x ∉ p" using Iterate(1,4) Query.prems(2) by auto
    ultimately show ?thesis using Iterate(4) by (auto split: if_splits)
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(2) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1,4)] Fixpoint(6) Iterate.prems(3) by auto
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5)] Iterate.prems(3) by auto
    have IH2: "p' ⊆ Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x}"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
            W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) IH1(1) Iterate.prems(2) by fastforce
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1,5)] N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(3) by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have IH1: "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1,3)] Iterate.prems(3) by auto
    have IH2: "p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(7) _
            Continue(9) Iterate.prems(2)] IH1(1) by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2) by auto
    have IH2: "p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Query(5)] IH1(1) by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by simp
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2) by auto
  qed
qed

lemma point_set_incr:
  shows "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ∧ p ⊆ p'"
    and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    ⟹ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x} ∧ Set.remove x p ⊆ p'"
    and "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    ⟹ p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
    ⟹ p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ∧ p ⊆ p'"
proof(induction y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post and x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    and y t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    arbitrary: xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post' and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate infl1 pinfl1 c1⇩w c1⇩n)
    have IH: "p' ⊆ c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x}" "Set.remove x p ⊆ p'"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,4) _ Iterate(3)] Iterate(4) Query.prems(2)
      by (auto split: if_splits)
    moreover have "x ∉ p" using Iterate(1,4) Query.prems(2) by auto
    ultimately show ?thesis using Iterate(4) by (auto split: if_splits)
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(2) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1,4)] Fixpoint(6) Iterate.prems(3) by auto
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" "p ⊆ p1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5)] Iterate.prems(3) by auto
    have IH2: "p' ⊆ Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x}" "Set.remove x p1 ⊆ p'"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
            W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) IH1(1) Iterate.prems(2) by fastforce+
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1,5)] N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(3) by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have IH1: "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" "p ⊆ p1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1,3)] Iterate.prems(3) by auto
    have IH2: "p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}" "Set.remove x p1 ⊆ p'"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(7) _
            Continue(9) Iterate.prems(2)] IH1(1) by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" "p ⊆ p1" using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2) by auto
    have IH2: "p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" "p1 ⊆ p'" 
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Query(5)] IH1(1) by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by simp
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2) by auto
  qed
qed

text‹While originally meant to prove that x is stable after iterating it, this lemma proves 
  a couple of helpful properties about the relation between the datastructures
  @{term c⇩w}, @{term c⇩n}, @{term infl} and @{term stabl} through necessary invariants along the way.›

lemma stabl_infl_properties:
    shows "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ stabl ⊆ stabl' ∧ fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'
          ∧ (∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {y}) = {})"
      and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
      ⟹ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
      ⟹ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ insert x stabl ⊆ stabl' ∧ fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'
          ∧ (∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {})"
      and "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ stabl ⊆ stabl' ∧ fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'
          ∧ (∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {})"
proof(induction y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post and x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    and y t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    arbitrary: xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post' and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate infl1 pinfl1 c1⇩w c1⇩n)
    have "x ∈ c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n" "c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl"
      using Iterate(4) Query.prems(2) by (auto split: if_splits) 
    then have IH: "insert x stabl ⊆ stabl'" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl'"
      "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {}"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,4) _ Iterate(3)] Query.prems(3) by auto
    show ?thesis
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case using IH(1) Iterate(4) by (auto split: if_splits)
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case using IH(1,2) Iterate(5) fmdom_fmupd unfolding fminsert_def by auto
    next
      case 3
      have IH': "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ stabl = {}"
        using IH(3) Iterate(2,3) by (cases "x ∈ stabl") auto
      then have "(slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {y}) = {}" for u
        using Iterate(5)
        by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
      then show ?case by auto
    qed
  next
    case Lookup
    have "x ∈ stabl'" using Lookup(1,4) Query(4) by blast
    moreover have "(slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {y}) = {}" for u
      using Lookup(3,4)
      by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
    ultimately show ?thesis using Query(4,5) Lookup(3,4) unfolding fminsert_def by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3,4) Stable(1,3,4) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    have "insert x stabl ⊆ stabl'" "fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'"
      "∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ stabl = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(2) Iterate.prems(3,4) Fixpoint(1,4) by blast+
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "stabl ⊆ stabl1" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl1"
      "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ stabl = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(2) Iterate.prems(3,4) W_Fixpoint(1,5) by blast+
    then have "influenced_by infl1 x ∩ stabl = {}"
      using new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of infl1 infl stabl x] W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4)
      by blast
    then have "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
        using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)] ‹stabl ⊆ stabl1› by auto
    then have "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl2" using Iterate.prems(3) by blast
    then have "Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl2"
      using Iterate.prems(2) by (cases "x ∈ c⇩w") auto
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      by (simp add: IH1(2) destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl W_Fixpoint(8))
    ultimately have IH2: "insert x stabl2 ⊆ stabl'" "fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'"
      "∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl2 u) ∩ (stabl2 - {x}) = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
            W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) Iterate.prems(2) by auto
    have "(slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {}" for u
    proof -
      have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u"
        using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)]
        by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subset_iff)
      then show ?thesis using IH2(3) IH1(3) ‹stabl ⊆ stabl2› by blast
    qed
    then show ?thesis using IH2 ‹stabl ⊆ stabl2› by (cases "x ∈ c⇩w") auto
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1,5)] N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(3,4) by blast
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have IH1: "insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl1"
        "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ (insert x stabl - {x}) = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1) Continue(3)] Iterate.prems(3,4) by blast+
    then have "influenced_by infl1 x ∩ stabl = {}"
      using new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of infl1 infl stabl x] Continue(1) Iterate.prems(4)
      by blast
    then have "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
      using ‹insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1› destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)] by blast
    then have "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl2" using Iterate.prems(3) by blast
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      by (simp add: IH1(2) destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl Continue(6))
    ultimately have IH2: "insert x stabl2 ⊆ stabl'" "fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'"
      "∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl2 u) ∩ (stabl2 - {x}) = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Continue(4,5,6) _ Continue(7) _
            Continue(9)] Iterate.prems(2) by auto
    have "(slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {}" for u
    proof -
      have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u"
        using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
        by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subset_iff)
      then show ?thesis using IH2(3) IH1(3) ‹stabl ⊆ stabl2› by blast
    qed
    then show ?thesis using IH2 ‹stabl ⊆ stabl2› by auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "stabl ⊆ stabl1" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl1"
        "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {}"
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2,3) by auto
    have "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl1" using IH1(1) Eval.prems(2) by auto
    then have IH2: "stabl1 ⊆ stabl'" "fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'"
        "∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl1 u) ∩ (stabl1 - {x}) = {}"
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Query(5)] IH1(2,3) by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 ‹stabl ⊆ stabl1› by blast
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2,3) by auto
  qed
qed

lemma called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point:
    shows "query_dom y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ {u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p
      ⟹ {u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
      and "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
      ⟹ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
      ⟹ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ {u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p - {x}
      ⟹ {u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
      and "eval_dom x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ (xd, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
      ⟹ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl
      ⟹ {u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p
      ⟹ {u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
proof(induction y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post and x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post
    and y t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post
    arbitrary: xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post' and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    and xd infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate infl1 pinfl1 c1⇩w c1⇩n)
    have IH: "{u ∈ c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x}. slookup infl1 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,4) _ Iterate(3)] Iterate(4) Query.prems(2-4)
      by (auto split: if_splits)
    moreover have "c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using Iterate(1,4) by (auto split: if_splits)
    ultimately show ?thesis using Iterate(1,5) slookup_fminsert_other[of _ x infl1 y] by force
  next
    case Lookup
    show ?thesis using Query.prems(2-4) Lookup(3,5) slookup_fminsert_other[of _ x infl y] by force
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(5) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint p1)
    have "slookup infl x = {}" using Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p" using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1,4)] Fixpoint(6) Iterate.prems(3-4) by force
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1)
    have "slookup infl x = {}" using W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p" using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then have IH1: "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl1 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5)] Iterate.prems(2-4) by auto
    have stabl_infl_props: "insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl1"
      "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ (insert x stabl - {x}) = {}"
      using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(4,5)] Iterate.prems(3-4) by auto
    have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u" for u
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)]
      by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
    then have "slookup infl1 u ≠ {}" if "slookup infl2 u ≠ {}" for u
      using that by (metis subset_empty)
    then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1 - {x}"
      using IH1 Iterate.prems(2) by blast
    then have "{u ∈ Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1 - {x}"
      using Iterate.prems(2) by auto
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF W_Fixpoint(8)] stabl_infl_props(2) by blast
    moreover have "Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "influenced_by infl1 x ∩ stabl = {}"
        using new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of infl1 infl stabl x] W_Fixpoint(1)
          Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_props(3) by blast
      then have "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
        using ‹insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1› destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)] by blast
      then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3) by auto
    qed
    ultimately have IH2: "{u ∈ Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ insert x c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1,5) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
            W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) Iterate.prems(2) by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 p1)
    have "slookup infl x = {}" using N_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p" using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1,5)] Iterate.prems(3,4) by auto
    then show ?thesis using N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(2) by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 d_new infl2 stabl2 pinfl1 post1 pinfl2 post2)
    have "slookup infl x = {}" using Continue(1) Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p" using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then have IH1: "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl1 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1,3)] Iterate.prems(3-5) by auto
    have stabl_infl_props: "insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl1"
      "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ (insert x stabl - {x}) = {}"
      using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF Continue(2,3)] Iterate.prems(3,4) by auto
    have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u" for u
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
      by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
    then have "slookup infl1 u ≠ {}" if "slookup infl2 u ≠ {}" for u
      by (metis subset_empty that)
    then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1 - {x}" using IH1 by blast
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF Continue(6)] using stabl_infl_props(2) by simp
    moreover have "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "influenced_by infl1 x ∩ stabl = {}"
        using new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of infl1 infl stabl x] Continue(1)
          Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_props(3) by blast
      then have "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
        using ‹insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1› destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)] by blast
      then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3) by simp
    qed
    ultimately have IH2: "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(7) _
            Continue(9) Iterate.prems(2)] IH1(1) by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd infl1 stabl1 p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1)
    have IH1: "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl1 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1"
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2-4) by auto
    have stabl_infl_props: "stabl ⊆ stabl1" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl1"
      "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ (insert x stabl - {x}) = {}"
      using stabl_infl_properties(1)[OF Query(2,3)] Eval.prems(2,3) by auto
    have IH2: "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'" 
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ _ _ _ _ _ Query(5)] IH1(1) stabl_infl_props(1,2)
        Eval.prems(2) by fast
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by simp
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2-4) by auto
  qed
qed


subsection‹Conditional Termination Proof›

abbreviation term_cond_aux where
  "term_cond_aux c infl stabl p ≡
    p ⊆ c ∧ c ⊆ stabl ∧ fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl ∧ {u ∈ c. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p"

abbreviation term_cond where
  "term_cond st ≡ (case st of
      Inl (_, _, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, _, _, _) ⇒ term_cond_aux (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl stabl p
    | Inr (Inl (x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, _, _, _, _)) ⇒ x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n
      ∧ term_cond_aux (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}) infl stabl (p - {x})
    | Inr (Inr (_, _, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, _, _, _)) ⇒ term_cond_aux (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) infl stabl p)"

lemma cond_termination: "query_iterate_eval_dom st" if "term_cond st"
  using wf_term_relation that
proof (induction st rule: wf_induct_rule[where ?r = term_relation])
  case (less st)
  then consider (Query) x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post where
      "st = Inl (x, y, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post)"
    | (Iterate) x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ wn pinfl post where
      "st = Inr (Inl (x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, wn, pinfl, post))"
    | (Eval) x t c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post where
      "st = Inr (Inr (x, t, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post))"
    by (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) sumE surj_pair)
  then show ?case
  proof cases
    case Query
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "y ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n")
      case True
      then show ?thesis using Query query_iterate_eval.domintros(1)[of y post c⇩w c⇩n] by blast
    next
      case False
      have "p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using less(2) Query by simp
      obtain c1⇩w c1⇩n where c1_def:
        "(c1⇩w, c1⇩n) = (if y ∈ post then (c⇩w, insert y c⇩n) else (insert y c⇩w, c⇩n))"
        by fastforce
      then have "c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n = insert y (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n)" using False by (auto split: if_splits)
      then have "card (UNIV - (c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n)) < card (UNIV - (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n))"
        using finite_vars False
        by (metis Diff_iff UNIV_I card_Diff_insert card_UNIV_unit card_gt_0_iff diff_less empty_iff
            finite_Diff finite_UNIV)
      then have "(c1⇩w ∪ c1⇩n, (c⇩w ∪ c⇩n)) ∈ c_relation"
        unfolding c_relation_def by (meson in_measure)
      then have "(Inr (Inl (y, c1⇩w, c1⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, Widening, pinfl, post)), st) ∈ term_relation"
        unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def Query by force
      moreover have "term_cond (Inr (Inl (y, c1⇩w, c1⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, Widening, pinfl, post)))"
        using c1_def less(2) Query by (auto split: if_splits)
      ultimately have "iterate_dom y c1⇩w c1⇩n infl stabl p σ Widening pinfl post"
        using less(1)[of "Inr (Inl (y, c1⇩w, c1⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, Widening, pinfl, post))"] by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using Query query_iterate_eval.domintros(1)[of y post c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ] c1_def False
        by (auto split: if_splits)
      qed
  next
    case Iterate
    have xcalled: "x ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" and p_sub_called: "p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using Iterate less(2) by auto
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "x ∈ stabl")
      case True
      then show ?thesis using Iterate query_iterate_eval.domintros(2) by blast
    next
      case False
      have "(Inr (Inr (x, T x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, insert x stabl, p, σ, pinfl, insert x post)), st) ∈
        term_relation"
        using Iterate unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def by simp
      moreover have "term_cond (Inr (Inr (x, T x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, insert x stabl, p, σ, pinfl,
        insert x post)))"
      proof -
        have "slookup infl x = {}" using less.prems Iterate stabl_infl_empty[OF False] by auto
        then show ?thesis using Iterate less.prems by auto
      qed
      ultimately have eval_dom:
        "eval_dom x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
        using less.IH by auto
      then obtain xd infl1 stabl1  p1 σ1 pinfl1 post1 where
          eval: "(xd, infl1, stabl1, p1, σ1, pinfl1, post1) = 
                 eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)"
        by (metis surj_pair)
      have "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" "p ⊆ p1" using point_set_incr(3)[OF eval_dom eval p_sub_called] by auto
      have stabl_infl_props1: "insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1" "fset (fmdom infl1) ⊆ stabl1"
          "∀u. (slookup infl1 u - slookup infl u) ∩ (insert x stabl - {x}) = {}"
        using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF eval_dom eval] less.prems Iterate
        by auto
      have non_empty_infl_point1: "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl1 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1"
      proof -
        have "slookup infl x = {}" using False less.prems Iterate stabl_infl_empty by auto
        then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p" using less.prems Iterate by auto
        then show ?thesis
          using called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point(3)[OF eval_dom eval] less.prems Iterate by auto
      qed

      obtain infl2 stabl2 where destab_stabl: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x infl1 stabl1"
        by (cases "destab x infl1 stabl1") simp
      have term_cond2: "p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
          "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x} ⊆ stabl2" "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
          "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1 - {x}"
      proof (goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case using Iterate less.prems point_set_incr(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
      next
        case 2
        have "influenced_by infl1 x ∩ stabl = {}"
          using new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of infl1 infl stabl x] False
            stabl_infl_props1(3) less.prems Iterate by auto
        then have "stabl ⊆ stabl2"
          using ‹insert x stabl ⊆ stabl1› destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl]
          by blast
        then show ?case using Iterate less.prems by auto
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case
          using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF destab_stabl] stabl_infl_props1(2)
          by simp
      next
        case 4
        have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup infl1 u" for u
          using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl]
          by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
        then show ?case using non_empty_infl_point1 subset_empty by fastforce
      qed

      show ?thesis
      proof (cases "x ∈ p")
        case True
        then show ?thesis
        proof (cases wn)
          case Widening
          show ?thesis
          proof (cases "mlup σ1 x = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd")
            case True
            show ?thesis
            proof (cases "mlup σ1 x Δ xd = mlup σ1 x")
              case True
              then show ?thesis
                using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl› ‹x ∈ p› eval_dom eval ‹mlup σ1 x = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd› Widening
                  query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post wn]
                by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
            next
              case False
              define st' where st': "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
                Inr (Inl (x, Set.remove x c⇩w, insert x c⇩n, infl2, stabl2, p1, σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd), Narrowing, pinfl1, post1))"
              have "insert x (Set.remove x c⇩w ∪ c⇩n) = c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using less(2) Iterate by auto
              moreover have "x ∈ p1" using ‹x ∈ p› ‹p ⊆ p1› by auto
              ultimately have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
                using st' Iterate ‹x ∈ p› Widening
                unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def value_relation_def by auto
              moreover have "term_cond st'" using term_cond2 st' by auto
              ultimately have
                "iterate_dom x (Set.remove x c⇩w) (insert x c⇩n) infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd)) Narrowing pinfl1 post1"
                using less(1)[OF ‹(st', st) ∈ term_relation›] st' ‹p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› xcalled by force
              then show ?thesis
                using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl› ‹x ∈ p› eval_dom eval True destab_stabl Widening
                  query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post]
                by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
                    cases "destab x infl1 stabl1", cases wn) auto
            qed
          next
            case False
            obtain pinfl2 post2 where
              destab_post: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
              by (cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2") simp

            define st' where st': "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
              Inr (Inl (x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl2, stabl2, p1, σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x ∇ xd), wn, pinfl2, post2))"
            have "x ∈ p1" using ‹x ∈ p› ‹p ⊆ p1› by auto
            moreover have
              "(mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x ∇ xd)) x, mlup σ x) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a}"
            proof -
              have "mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x ∇ xd)) x = mlup σ1 x ∇ xd"
                unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
              moreover have "mlup σ1 x = mlup σ x"
                using constant_vals_for_called(3)[OF eval_dom eval] xcalled by blast
              moreover have "mlup σ x ∇ xd ≠ mlup σ x" using False ‹mlup σ1 x = mlup σ x› by simp
              ultimately show ?thesis by auto
            qed
            ultimately have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
              using st' Iterate ‹x ∈ p› Widening
