              unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def value_relation_def by auto
            moreover have "term_cond st'" using term_cond2 st' xcalled by auto
            ultimately have
              "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x ∇ xd)) wn pinfl2 post2"
              using less st' Iterate ‹p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› xcalled by force
            then show ?thesis
              using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl› ‹x ∈ p› eval_dom eval False destab_stabl destab_post Widening
                query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post]
              by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
                  cases "destab x infl1 stabl1", cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2",
                  cases wn) auto
          qed
        next
          case Narrowing
          show ?thesis
          proof (cases "mlup σ1 x = mlup σ1 x Δ xd")
            case True
            then show ?thesis
              using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl› ‹x ∈ p› eval_dom eval Narrowing
              query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post]
            by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
          next
            case False
            obtain pinfl2 post2 where
              destab_post: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
              by (cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2") simp

            define st' where st': "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
              Inr (Inl (x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl2, stabl2, p1, σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd), wn, pinfl2, post2))"
            have "x ∈ p1" using ‹x ∈ p› ‹p ⊆ p1› by auto
            moreover have
              "(mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd)) x, mlup σ x) ∈ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a}"
            proof -
              have "mlup (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd)) x = mlup σ1 x Δ xd"
                unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
              moreover have "mlup σ1 x = mlup σ x"
                using constant_vals_for_called(3)[OF eval_dom eval] xcalled by blast
              moreover have "mlup σ x Δ xd ≠ mlup σ x" using False ‹mlup σ1 x = mlup σ x› by auto
              ultimately show ?thesis by auto
            qed
            ultimately have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
              using Iterate st' Narrowing unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def value_relation_def
              by auto
            moreover have "term_cond st'" using term_cond2 st' xcalled by auto
            ultimately have
              "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ mlup σ1 x Δ xd)) wn pinfl2 post2"
              using less st' Iterate ‹p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› xcalled by force
            then show ?thesis
              using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl› ‹x ∈ p› eval_dom eval False destab_stabl destab_post Narrowing
                query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post]
              by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
                  cases "destab x infl1 stabl1", cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2",
                  cases wn) auto
          qed
        qed
      next
        case False
        show ?thesis
        proof (cases "mlup σ1 x = xd")
          case True
          then show ?thesis
            using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl› ‹x ∉ p› eval_dom eval
              query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post]
            by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)") auto
        next
          case False
          obtain pinfl2 post2 where
            destab_post: "(pinfl2, post2) = destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2"
            by (cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2") simp

          define st' where st': "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
            Inr (Inl (x, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl2, stabl2, p1, σ1(x ↦ xd), wn, pinfl2, post2))"

          have "iterate_dom x c⇩w c⇩n infl2 stabl2 p1 (σ1(x ↦ xd)) wn pinfl2 post2"
          proof (cases "x ∈ p1")
            case True
            then have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
              using st' Iterate ‹x ∉ p› unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def by auto
            moreover have "term_cond st'" using term_cond2 st' xcalled by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis using less st' Iterate ‹p1 ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› xcalled by force
          next
            case False
            have prems: "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ insert x stabl" "fset (fmdom infl) ⊆ stabl"
                "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n - {x}. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p - {x}"
              using less.prems Iterate by auto
            have "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl1"
              using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF eval_dom eval] prems(1,2) by fast
            have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl u ≠ {}} ⊆ p"
            proof -
              have "slookup infl x = {}" using ‹x ∉ stabl› prems(2) stabl_infl_empty by simp
              then show ?thesis using prems(3) by auto
            qed
            then have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl1 u ≠ {}} ⊆ p1"
              using called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point(3)[OF eval_dom eval] prems(1,2) by auto
            then have "slookup infl1 x = {}" using False xcalled by blast
            then have "influenced_by infl1 x = {}" using influenced_by_aux by force
            then have "stabl1 = stabl2" using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl] by simp
            then have "x ∈ stabl2" using xcalled ‹c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl1› by blast
            then show ?thesis using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2) by force
          qed
          then show ?thesis
            using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl› ‹x ∉ p› eval_dom eval False destab_stabl destab_post
              query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x stabl c⇩w c⇩n infl p σ pinfl post]
            by (cases "eval x (T x) c⇩w c⇩n infl (insert x stabl) p σ pinfl (insert x post)",
                cases "destab x infl1 stabl1", cases "destab_post x post pinfl1 post1 stabl2",
                cases wn) auto
        qed
      qed
    qed
  next
    case Eval
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases t)
      case (Answer d)
      then show ?thesis using Eval query_iterate_eval.domintros(3) by fastforce
    next
      case (Query y g)
      have "p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using Eval less(2) by simp
      have "(Inl (x, y, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post), st) ∈ term_relation"
        unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def Eval by simp
      moreover have "term_cond (Inl (x, y, c⇩w, c⇩n, infl, stabl, p, σ, pinfl, post))"
        using less.prems Eval by simp
      ultimately have query_dom: "query_dom x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
        using less.IH ‹p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› by simp
      then obtain σ' infl' stabl' p' d' pinfl' post' where query:
        "(d', infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post') = query x y c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ pinfl post"
        by (metis surj_pair)
      have "p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n" using point_set_incr(1)[OF query_dom query] ‹p ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› by simp

      have "eval_dom x (g d') c⇩w c⇩n infl' stabl' p' σ' pinfl' post'"
      proof -
        have "d' = mlup σ' y" using query_fmlookup query_dom_def query query_dom by metis
        then have "(g d', t) ∈ strict_subt_relation"
          using Query direct_subt.intros by fastforce
        then have "(Inr (Inr (x, g d', c⇩w, c⇩n, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post')), st)
          ∈ term_relation"
          using Eval unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def by simp
        moreover have
          "term_cond (Inr (Inr (x, g d', c⇩w, c⇩n, infl', stabl', p', σ', pinfl', post')))"
        proof -
          have "p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n"
            using Eval point_set_incr(1)[OF query_dom query] less.prems Eval by simp
          moreover have "stabl ⊆ stabl'" "fset (fmdom infl') ⊆ stabl'"
              "(∀u. (slookup infl' u - slookup infl u) ∩ (stabl - {x}) = {})"
            using less.prems Eval stabl_infl_properties(1)[OF query_dom query] by auto
          moreover have "c⇩w ∪ c⇩n ⊆ stabl" using less.prems Eval by simp
          moreover have "{u ∈ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n. slookup infl' u ≠ {}} ⊆ p'"
            using less.prems Eval called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point(1)[OF query_dom query]
            by simp
          ultimately show ?thesis by auto
        qed
        ultimately show ?thesis using less.IH ‹p' ⊆ c⇩w ∪ c⇩n› unfolding eval_dom_def by auto
      qed
      then show ?thesis
        using query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[of t x c⇩w c⇩n infl stabl p σ] Query Eval query query_dom
        unfolding query_dom_def eval_dom_def
        by (smt (verit, best) Pair_inject strategy_tree.inject(2))
    qed
  qed
qed

corollary solve_termination: "solve_dom x"
  unfolding solve_dom_def using cond_termination by auto

end
end ― ‹end of context for termination proof›

end
